JOB TITLE: Database Administrator (Microsoft SQL Server & PostgreSQL)

Experience: 1-4+ years as a Database Administrator

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Database Administrator to run our Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL databases. These databases support production

platforms, so the role covers high availability, disaster recovery, backups, performance tuning and data integration (ETL) across

production and non-production environments.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Microsoft SQL Server

- Install, configure, patch and upgrade SQL Server instances.

- Configure and maintain Always On Availability Groups and Failover Clustering.

- Design and run backup and recovery, including point-in-time recovery.

- Apply security controls: access management, encryption (TDE) and auditing.

T-SQL

- Review and optimise stored procedures, functions, views and triggers.

- Review and improve the T-SQL written by application teams.

- Support schema changes, indexing strategy and data model reviews.

- Troubleshoot deadlocks, blocking and long-running transactions.

Performance Tuning

- Analyse and tune slow queries using execution plans, Query Store,

Extended Events and SQL Profiler.

- Design and maintain indexes, statistics and partitioning.

- Investigate wait statistics, blocking, tempdb contention and I/O bottlenecks.

- Do capacity planning and act on growth trends.

- On PostgreSQL: use EXPLAIN (ANALYZE), pg\_stat\_statements, autovacuum tuning and memory parameters.

ETL and Data Integration

- Build and maintain SSIS packages and data integration jobs.

- Schedule, monitor and troubleshoot ETL jobs and SQL Server Agent jobs.

- Support data migration between systems and environments.

- Make sure data loads are reliable, with error handling and reprocessing.

PostgreSQL

- Install, configure and upgrade PostgreSQL on Linux.

- Set up and maintain streaming replication and high availability (Patroni or an equivalent).

- Run backup and point-in-time recovery using pgBackRest or Barman.

- Write and tune PL/pgSQL functions.

- Manage connection pooling (PgBouncer) and authentication (pg\_hba.conf).

Operations

- Provide day-to-day support: incidents, service requests and change requests.

- Do root cause analysis and write postmortems for major incidents.

- Automate routine database work (Ansible, PowerShell or shell scripting).

- Set up monitoring and alerting.

- Run disaster recovery tests and keep documentation current.

- Take part in an on-call rotat

**Job Overview**

The Warehouse Keeper will be responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the warehouse, ensuring the efficient and accurate management of inventory. This role includes supervising warehouse staff, maintaining inventory accuracy, and ensuring compliance with safety regulations. The Warehouse Keeper will play a critical role in coordinating with other departments to support the company’s logistics and inventory needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Warehouse Operations Management:**

* Supervise warehouse workers to ensure smooth and efficient operations.
* Ensure ease of withdrawal and receipt from inventory based on the nature of withdrawal type and adhere to the FIFO (First In, First Out) principle.
* Continuously plan and monitor warehouse activities, including sending daily and periodic reports, and maintain proficiency in using computer systems.

* **Inventory Control and Planning:**

* Secure the storage area by accurately recording items on item cards and their respective systems, ensuring related information and item locations are organized for easy access.
* Conduct all receiving operations, verify item specifications, quantities, and types against purchase orders, and record them within inventory balances.
* Communicate with the financial manager and procurement department regarding stock status and discrepancies.

* **Data Accuracy and Compliance:**

* Work closely with the financial department to ensure the correct quantities of received goods are entered into the company's inventory program.
* Ensure all received items have appropriate packaging labels indicating production date, shelf life, expiry date, item name, and quantity.
* Review the shelf life monthly and inform warehouse management when the shelf life reaches one-quarter of the specified period.
* Ensure continuous application of safety and security measures in the warehouse.

* **Product Dispatch and Quality Assurance:**

* Ensure goods are delivered to clients in excellent condition after thorough verification of quantity and product safety.
* Notify the inventory manager of product shortages in the warehouse to ensure timely replenishment.
* Maintain the cleanliness of the warehouse inside and out to prevent dirt accumulation on goods.

* **Communication and Coordination:**

* Inform the logistics department of branch vehicle conditions and send maintenance and trip reports regularly.
* Perform any additional tasks assigned by the departme

Location: Doha, Qatar | ***Practice Area***: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

**The Role**

Capco is looking for an AI Security Consultant to help our clients identify, assess, and manage security risks associated with AI technologies and AI-enabled solutions. You'll work across data, security, technology, risk, and business teams to embed appropriate security controls throughout the lifecycle of AI systems.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, data, and cybersecurity within financial services, helping clients adopt AI securely while protecting sensitive information, strengthening governance, and managing emerging security risks.

**What You'll Do**

* Assess security risks associated with AI systems, models, data pipelines, and supporting technology environments.
* Conduct AI security assessments and secure AI architecture reviews.
* Define and implement security controls, standards, and guardrails across the AI lifecycle, from design and development through deployment and ongoing operation.
* Identify and assess AI-specific threats and vulnerabilities, including risks relating to data exposure, model access, prompt manipulation, and misuse.
* Deliver cybersecurity advisory services supporting enterprise AI adoption.
* Support clients in securing AI-enabled products, platforms and data ecosystems.
* Work with data, security, architecture, engineering, risk, and business teams to embed security-by-design into AI solutions and delivery processes.
* Support AI security governance, risk assessments, control testing, monitoring, incident response, and remediation activities.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong experience in cybersecurity, information security, AI security, data security, or related technology risk disciplines.
* Practical understanding of AI and machine learning environments and the security risks associated with models, data, applications, and supporting infrastructure.
* Experience applying security controls, threat modelling, risk assessment, identity and access management, data protection, and secure architecture principles.
* Strong understanding of security governance, responsible AI, regulatory requirements, and security-by-design principles.
* Clear communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical AI security risks into practical business and risk considerations.

**Bonus Points For**

* Experience delivering AI, data, or cybersecurity initiatives within banking

**Job Summary**

The Operations Director leads TGP International's food and beverage operations across a multi-site, multi-location portfolio, covering venues that TGP owns and operates, venues that TGP operates or manages on behalf of clients, and the F&B operations consultancy delivered to clients on new projects and openings. Every site is run to the same operating principles, standards and disciplines regardless of ownership.

This is a commercially creative role first. The Operations Director is expected to grow revenue: to find, test and scale new income streams, to improve trading performance in existing venues, and to bring ideas that make each site more compelling to its market. That sits alongside full accountability for profit and loss, operating standards, guest experience, brand curation and compliance across the portfolio, and for the leadership and development of the venue teams.

The role requires regular travel between venue and project locations, with regional and international travel as required. As part of the management team, the Operations Director contributes to company policy and maintains open communication with the Country Director and the company support office.

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

**1.** **Revenue Generation and Commercial Creativity**

* Own the revenue performance of the portfolio and set the growth plan for each site, covering sales, covers, average spend and revenue mix.
* Generate and bring forward commercial ideas: new concepts, formats, menus, dayparts, offers, events, partnerships and activations that create measurable incremental revenue.
* Identify and develop new income streams beyond core trade, such as events and private hire, catering, delivery and off-premise, retail and merchandise, membership, sponsorship and commercial partnerships.

* Assign risk ratings using CVSS and applicable customer risk-classification methodologies.

* Present assessment findings and risk remediation plans to technical and business stakeholders.
* Conduct remediation workshops and provide technical guidance to customer teams.

**About ExeQut**
ExeQut is an IT consulting, cybersecurity, and digital transformation firm headquartered in Lanham, MD, with delivery operations across the US and the MENA region. Since 2014, we have delivered 165+ projects across federal and public sector, healthcare, financial services, and enterprise clients. Our tagline: Where Action Meets Impact
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Engineer with hands-on expertise in Forcepoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Seclore Digital Rights Management (DRM), and CrowdStrike endpoint security solutions. The successful candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, integrating, maintaining, and supporting cybersecurity solutions that protect sensitive data, prevent unauthorized information disclosure, and secure enterprise endpoints against cyber threats. The role requires strong technical troubleshooting skills, security policy management experience, and the ability to work with enterprise customers and IT teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Forcepoint DLP
  
  

* Install, configure, and administer Forcepoint DLP solutions.
* Develop and enforce data loss prevention policies based on organizational requirements.
* Configure endpoint, network, email, and web data protection controls, as applicable to the deployed architecture.
* Perform troubleshooting, system health monitoring, and performance optimization.

Seclore DRM (Digital Rights Management)
  
  

* Implement and administer Seclore Data-Centric Security / DRM solutions.
* Configure information protection policies based on user roles, groups, departments, and data sensitivity.
* Configure document access control, usage restrictions, and rights management.

job_description:
We are looking for an experienced SOC L3 (DFIR) Engineer to serve as a senior escalation point within our Security Operations Center. In this role, you will lead complex incident response investigations, perform digital forensics, and drive SIEM engineering and tuning efforts to enhance detection capabilities. You will play a critical role in protecting our clients' environments and mentoring junior SOC analysts.

  

* Act as the primary escalation point for complex and high-severity security incidents escalated from L1 and L2 analysts
* Lead end-to-end incident response investigations including containment, eradication, and recovery
* Conduct digital forensics analysis on endpoints, networks, and logs to determine root cause and impact
* Engineer, fine-tune, and optimize SIEM use cases, correlation rules, and alerting logic to reduce false positives and improve detection accuracy
* Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and SOC procedures
* Collaborate with the CTI team to integrate threat intelligence into detection and response workflows
* Provide mentorship and technical guidance to L1 and L2 analysts
* Prepare detailed incident reports and present findings to management and clients

  

* 2–5 years of experience in a SOC environment, with hands-on experience at L3 level(DFIR)
* Strong expertise in incident response and digital forensics methodologies
* Proven hands-on experience with SIEM platforms (e.g. Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, or similar) including rule creation and tuning
* Solid understanding of network protocols, attack techniques, and threat actor TTPs
* Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK framework and its application in detection engineering
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
* Saudi nationals only

**Preferred**

* Relevant certifications are a plus (GCIH, GCFE, GCFA, Splunk Certified, Microsoft SC-200, or equivalent)
* Knowledge of Saudi Arabia's NCA cybersecurity regulations and compliance requirements

We are seeking a proactive and customer-focused Application Support Engineer to provide technical support, maintenance, and operational management for business-critical applications. The ideal candidate will ensure high application availability, troubleshoot production issues, coordinate with development and infrastructure teams, and support application deployments while maintaining service level agreements (SLAs)..

**YOU WILL**

* Provide Level 2/Level 3 support for enterprise applications in production and non-production environments.
* Monitor application health, availability, and performance using monitoring and alerting tools.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and implement preventive measures.
* Coordinate with development, database, infrastructure, and network teams to resolve complex technical issues.
* Support application deployments, upgrades, patches, and configuration changes.
* Execute application validation and post-deployment verification activities.
* Monitor application logs and identify performance bottlenecks or system errors.
* Manage user accounts, application access, and permissions in accordance with security policies.
* Document incidents, known errors, operational procedures, and support runbooks.
* Participate in disaster recovery testing and business continuity activities.
* Provide on-call and after-hours production support as required.
* Participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, maintenance windows, audit support, and continuous improvement activities..

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* ITIL Foundation certification is preferred.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS is an advantage.
* Familiarity with DevOps tools, CI/CD pipelines, and version control systems (Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, etc.).
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Grafana, or Kibana

job_description:
DOCUMENT CONTROLLER – FEMALE

**Department:** Projects / Project Management  
**Location:** Head Office - Riyadh  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

1. JOB PURPOSE

Responsible for the management, control, distribution, tracking, and archiving of all project documentation throughout the project lifecycle. Ensure that project teams have access to the latest approved drawings and documents, with proper revision control, traceability, and filing.

2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIESDocument & Drawing Control

* Receive, register, classify, distribute, and archive all project documents.
* Maintain Master Document, Drawing, and Revision Registers.
* Control document numbering, revisions, status, and distribution.
* Ensure superseded documents are identified and removed from active use.
* Maintain electronic and hard-copy filing systems.
* Control architectural, civil, structural, MEP, shop, coordination, and as-built drawings.
* Ensure site teams receive the latest approved drawings and revisions.
* Maintain technical specifications, material submittals, method statements, samples, testing/commissioning documents, and O&M manuals.

RFI, Submittal & Correspondence Control

* Register and track RFIs, material submittals, method statements, and technical submissions.
* Monitor submission, review, approval, response, and closure status.
* Register incoming/outgoing letters, emails, instructions, notices, and meeting minutes.
* Prepare and issue transmittals and maintain related registers.
* Follow up on overdue submissions, comments, and responses.

Project Management Systems

* Manage documents through platforms such as **Aconex, Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, SharePoint, Asite, Oracle Unifier, Microsoft Teams/OneDrive**, or client-specific systems.
* Ensure documents comply with project naming, numbering, revision, and workflow requirements.

3. PROJECT COORDINATION

Coordinate with the Project Manager, Planning Engineer, Technical Office, Project Engineers, QA/QC, HSE, Procurement, Commercial/Quantity Surveying, Site Engineers, Subcontractors, Suppliers, Consultant, and Client.

Ensure new submissions, approvals, comments, revisions, instructions, and outstanding actions are communicated to the relevant personnel.

4. DOCUMENT REGISTERS

Maintain and regularly update, as applicable:

* Master Document & Drawing Registers
* Drawing Revision Register
* RFI Register
* Material / Technical Submittal Register
* Method Statement Register
* Transmittal & Correspondence Regist

Purpose:

To drive the reliability, availability, scalability, and operational resilience of critical technology services by applying advanced software engineering, automation, observability, and reliability engineering practices.

Main Duties and Responsibilities:

* Define and implement advanced reliability engineering practices across critical technology services.
* Establish and monitor Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and reliability targets.
* Design automation to reduce manual operational activities and improve system resilience.
* Develop and enhance monitoring, observability, alerting, and incident detection capabilities.
* Lead technical analysis and resolution of complex production incidents.
* Conduct root-cause analysis and drive permanent corrective and preventive actions.
* Design solutions to improve system availability, scalability, capacity, and disaster resilience.
* Identify reliability risks and recommend architectural and engineering improvements.
* Drive performance engineering and capacity planning for critical services.
* Provide advanced technical guidance and mentorship on SRE practices.
* Promote automation and engineering approaches that reduce operational toil and improve service reliability.

  
**Requirements**  
  
QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

* Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related field**.
* **5+ years of experience** in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or related roles.
* Strong experience in **cloud platforms, Kubernetes, and production environments**.
* Strong knowledge of **monitoring, observability, alerting, SLIs, SLOs, and reliability metrics**.
* Hands-on experience with **automation, scripting, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)**.
* Proven experience in **complex incident management, troubleshooting, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**.
* Strong understanding of **high availability, scalability, performance engineering, capacity planning, and disaster recovery**.
* Experience driving **reliability improvements and reducing operational toil through automation**.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and **technical leadership** skills.
* Experience in **Banking, FinTech, or Payment environments** is preferred.

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Infrastructure Engineer** to design, implement, maintain, and optimize enterprise IT infrastructure environments. job_description:
The **Senior IT Security Operations Engineer** safeguards corporate IT infrastructure, networks, enterprise data, and cloud environments against operational security risks and threats. This hands-on role bridges infrastructure management with threat detection, incident response, IAM governance, and security standard compliance across enterprise systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Infrastructure & Network Defense:** Configure, manage, and audit enterprise firewalls, VPNs, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents, and web proxy controls.
* **Security Monitoring & Incident Response:** Lead Tier-2/Tier-3 security event investigations, analyze SIEM logs, and mitigate security incidents to limit operational downtime.
* **Identity & Access Governance:** Enforce strict identity and access management (IAM) controls, privileged access management (PAM), multi-factor authentication, and role-based access policies.
* **Vulnerability & Patch Management:** Direct routine infrastructure vulnerability scans, prioritize critical patching schedules with IT infrastructure teams, and verify system hardening.
* **Backup Integrity & System Audits:** Ensure secure backup configurations, system disaster recovery readiness, and adherence to security standards (ITIL, ISO 27001, NCA-ECC).

  
**Requirements**  

* **1.** Minimum **6+ years of hands-on experience** in IT security administration, SOC engineering, or network security operations.
* **2.** Advanced proficiency with core security solutions including **SIEM tools (Splunk, QRadar, Sentinel), EDR platforms (CrowdStrike, Defender), and Next-Gen Firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet)**.
* **3.** Strong expertise in **Identity & Access Management (Active Directory, Entra ID, PAM solutions)**, multi-factor authentication, and network access controls.
* **4.** Proven track record in **threat detection, incident response, log analysis, and system hardening** across Windows/Linux servers and cloud platforms (Azure/AWS).
* **5.** Hold at least one active industry certification such as **CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CEH, CCSP, or ITIL4**.

job_description:
The Document Controller is responsible for the receipt, registration, distribution, filing, tracking, retrieval, and archiving of project and corporate documents. The role ensures that all documentation is maintained in accordance with company procedures, quality standards, and contractual requirements.

Key ResponsibilitiesDocument Management

* Control and maintain project documentation in accordance with company standards and procedures.
* Receive, register, categorize, distribute, and archive incoming and outgoing documents.
* Maintain document numbering, revision control, and approval workflows.
* Ensure all documents are accurately logged in the Document Management System (DMS).
* Monitor document submissions, approvals, and overdue actions.

Records & Compliance

* Maintain up-to-date records of all project correspondence, drawings, specifications, reports, and other controlled documents.
* Ensure compliance with document control processes, ISO standards, and client requirements.
* Perform regular audits to verify document accuracy and completeness.
* Protect confidential information and ensure proper access controls.

Coordination & Reporting

* Coordinate with project teams, consultants, contractors, and clients regarding document submissions and revisions.
* Generate document status reports, transmittals, and registers.
* Support project managers and engineers in document retrieval and distribution.
* Track document review cycles and follow up on pending approvals.

Archiving

* Manage electronic and physical filing systems.
* Ensure project documents are archived according to company retention policies.
* Facilitate document handover and closeout activities at project completion.

Qualifications

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* Certification in Document Control or Records Management is an advantage.

Experience

* 2-5 years of experience as a Document Controller, preferably within construction, engineering, infrastructure, or project-based environments.
* Experience using Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS) such as Aconex, Procore, SharePoint, Autodesk Construction Cloud, or similar platforms.

The **Senior IT Security Operations Architect** designs, builds, and governs the overarching security operations framework, SOC architecture, and threat mitigation strategies across enterprise hybrid infrastructure. This strategic and technical role aligns operational security systems (SIEM/SOAR, EDR, IAM, Network Defense) with business goals, cloud environments, and national compliance standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Architecture & Strategy Design:** Design scalable security architectures for enterprise hybrid environments (On-Premises, AWS, Azure), integrating Zero Trust models and operational security controls.
* **SOC & SOAR Integration:** Build and optimize Security Operations Center (SOC) workflows, automation playbooks (SOAR), and SIEM architecture to reduce incident response time and eliminate operational fatigue.
* **Security Tool Engineering Oversight:** Architect the deployment and lifecycle management of Next-Gen Firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet), EDR/XDR ecosystems, PAM, and Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) tools.
* **Threat Intelligence & Resilience:** Establish proactive threat-hunting programs, red/blue team operational alignment, and high-availability disaster recovery frameworks.
* **Governance & Regulatory Compliance:** Ensure all operational security designs strictly comply with local regulatory frameworks (NCA-ECC, SAMA CSF) and global standards (ISO 27001, NIST).

  
**Requirements**  

* **1.** Minimum **10+ years of progressive experience** in IT security, with at least **4+ years as a Security Architect or Principal Security Engineer** managing enterprise SOC frameworks.
* **2.** Deep expertise in **designing enterprise SOC pipelines, SIEM/SOAR architectures (Splunk, Sentinel, Cortex), and automated incident response playbooks**.
* **3.** Proven track record in **hybrid cloud security architecture (Azure, AWS) and Zero Trust Network Architecture (ZTNA) implementations**.
* **4.** Hands-on mastery of **governance frameworks and local regulatory compliance (NCA-ECC, SAMA, ISO 27001, NIST CSF)** in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC.
* **5.** Hold advanced architecture certifications such as **CISSP-ISSAP, CISM, SABSA, TOGAF, or CCSP**.

* Monitoring

job_description:
The Assistant Manager - Cloud Operations is responsible for supporting the day-to-day operation, reliability, governance, security, and optimization of Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments. The role works closely with infrastructure, security, application, service desk, vendors, managed service providers, and business stakeholders to ensure cloud services are stable, secure, resilient, cost-effective, and aligned with business requirements.
  
  
The role also supports Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, including service availability, monitoring, incident response, reliability improvement, automation, and operational excellence.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support daily cloud operations across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Monitor cloud infrastructure health, availability, performance, capacity, and incidents.
* Support SRE practices, including reliability monitoring, availability improvement, incident response, service health reviews, and operational automation.
* Manage incident response, service requests, escalations, and root cause analysis for cloud services.
* Support implementation and maintenance of cloud governance, policies, standards, tagging, and compliance controls.
* Review and optimize cloud cost, usage, reserved capacity, rightsizing, and resource cleanup.
* Coordinate with vendors, managed service providers, and internal teams to resolve operational issues.
* Support native backup, disaster recovery, high availability, and business continuity activities.
* Maintain cloud documentation, operational runbooks, architecture diagrams, and knowledge base articles.
* Support cloud security operations, including IAM reviews, network security, patching, vulnerability remediation, encryption, and access governance.
* Assist with automation and Infrastructure as Code adoption using tools such as Terraform.
* Track operational KPIs such as availability, incident resolution, SLA compliance, policy violations, cost optimization, reliability metrics, and documentation coverage.
* Participate in change management, release coordination, and operational readiness reviews.

Containerization & Orchestration:

* Implement and manage containerization (Docker) and orchestration tools (Kubernetes, ECS).

System Automation:

* Automate system configurations, deployments, and scaling using configuration management tools (Ansible, etc.).

Security & Compliance:

* Maintain and improve system security, compliance, and backup strategies.

Collaboration with Development Teams:

* Collaborate with development teams to optimize applications for performance, scalability, and resilience.

System Performance & Capacity Planning:

* Conduct regular system performance testing, tuning, and capacity planning.

Documentation & Operational Excellence:

* Document processes, procedures, and environments to ensure operational excellence.

* Ability to obtain updated soft and technical skills related to the job.

Delivery:

* Perform the planned activities to meet the operational and development targets as per delivery schedules.
* Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time.
* Provide a periodic report formatted by detailing the deviation and execution of planned tasks.

Problem-Solving:

* Solve any related problems arise and escalate any complex operational issues.

Quality:

* Ensure quality requirements to develop effective quality control and processes including specifications for products or processes or related activities.

job_description:
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented PMIS Administrator with expertise in Unifier and Primavera P6 to join our team focused on water and wastewater projects. The PMIS Administrator will be responsible for the administration, configuration, maintenance, and support of project management information systems (PMIS), including Oracle Primavera Unifier and Primavera P6, to facilitate effective project planning, scheduling, and execution.

  

* System Administration:

a. Administer and configure Oracle Primavera Unifier and Primavera P6 systems to meet project
  
requirements and user needs.
  
b. Set up and maintain project structures, data hierarchies, user access controls, security profiles, and
  
other system configurations.
  
c. Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement system upgrades, patches, and
  
enhancements as needed.
  

* Data Management:

a. Manage project data within Unifier and P6 systems, including project schedules, budgets, contracts,
  
documents, and other project-related information.
  
b. Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across the PMIS platforms.
  
c. Develop and implement data management processes, standards, and procedures to streamline data
  
entry, validation, and retrieval.
  

* User Support and Training:

a. Provide technical support and assistance to project teams, users, and stakeholders on PMIS
  
functionalities, processes, and workflows.
  
b. Conduct user training sessions, workshops, and tutorials to onboard new users and enhance existing
  
users' proficiency in Unifier and P6.
  
c. Create user documentation, manuals, and guides to facilitate self-service support and
  
troubleshooting.
  

* Integration and Reporting:

a. Coordinate integration efforts between Unifier, P6, and other project management tools and systems.
  
b. Develop and maintain standard and ad-hoc reports, dashboards, and analytics to support project
  
planning, monitoring, and decision-making.
  
c. Collaborate with project teams to identify reporting requirements, customize reports, and automate
  
report generation processes.
  

* Process Improvement:

a. Identify opportunities for process improvements, system enhancements, and automation within
  
Unifier and P6.
  
b. Recommend and implement best practices, workflows, and methodologies to optimize project
  
management processes and increase efficiency.

  

* Minimum of 4 years of work experience.
* Experienced in Primavera Functional Support.

job_description:
Job Purpose

To provide technical and functional support for the ServiceNow platform, with a focus on Service Management and Change Management processes. The role will ensure the stability, availability, and continuous improvement of ServiceNow services while supporting ITSM operations within a banking environment.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide **L2/L3 support** for ServiceNow, including incident, problem, request, and change management processes.
* Administer and support **ServiceNow ITSM modules**, ensuring reliable and efficient day-to-day operations.
* Manage and support **Change Management workflows**, approvals, change scheduling, risk assessment, and implementation processes.
* Troubleshoot and resolve ServiceNow incidents, defects, workflow issues, and integration-related problems.
* Monitor ServiceNow platform performance and identify recurring issues or opportunities for improvement.
* Configure and maintain ServiceNow forms, workflows, business rules, notifications, SLAs, and user access based on approved requirements.
* Support **Change Advisory Board (CAB)** activities and ensure changes follow established governance and approval procedures.
* Work closely with IT Operations, Infrastructure, Application Support, Development, and other technology teams to resolve ServiceNow-related issues.
* Support integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems and coordinate troubleshooting with relevant technical teams.
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring incidents and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Prepare operational reports and dashboards related to incidents, requests, changes, SLAs, and service performance.
* Ensure ServiceNow processes and configurations align with **ITSM best practices, internal controls, and banking policies**.
* Participate in ServiceNow upgrades, releases, enhancements, testing, and deployment activities.
* Maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, support procedures, and configuration records.
* Ensure compliance with information security, audit, risk, and regulatory requirements applicable to the banking environment.
* Participate in **24/7 support and on-call activities**, when required.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* **4–7 years of experience** in ServiceNow administration, support, or ITSM platform operations.
* Hands-on experience with **ServiceNow ITSM**, particularly Incident, Problem, Request

We are seeking an experienced **DBA Lead / Database Architect** to join a leading global organization in the Aerospace & Defense sector based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.

* Establish database administration standards, governance, and best practices.

* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to database administrators and engineers.

* Experience managing large-scale production environments.

We are seeking a
**Red Hat Linux Administrator**
with strong hands-on experience in
**RHEL server administration, OS patching, hardening, environment configuration, and production support**
. The ideal candidate will be responsible for maintaining the availability, performance, security, and reliability of Linux environments across development, testing, and production.

* Administer and support
  **Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)**
  servers across enterprise environments.
* Perform
  **OS installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, and system hardening**
  .

* Manage users, groups, permissions, services, filesystems, processes, and system configurations.
* Support production environments and participate in
  **incident, problem, and change management**
  activities.
* Implement security best practices, vulnerability remediation, and configuration standards.
* Automate routine administrative tasks using
  **Shell scripting and/or Ansible**
  .

  administration and troubleshooting.

  .
* Experience with
  **OS patching, server hardening, vulnerability remediation, and configuration management**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **Shell scripting and/or Ansible**
  .
* Familiarity with monitoring, logging, backup, and enterprise infrastructure tools.
* Experience working in
  **24x7 production support**
  environments and following ITIL-based operational processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and incident-management skills.
* **RHCSA/RHCE certification**
  or equivalent experience will be an advantage.

**Contact Center Technical Engineer**
, you will manage the installation, configuration, maintenance, and support of core platforms and services that power contact center solutions. * Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade Nginx, MySQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, and FreeSWITCH.

* Hands-on experience with Linux, Nginx, MySQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, and FreeSWITCH.
* Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VPN.
* Experience with Ansible and scripting using Bash; basic Python skills are preferred.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* RHCSA, RHCE, Ansible, or relevant database and networking certifications.

* Monitor backup jobs, investigate failures, and perform file, database, virtual machine, and application restores.

* Support disaster recovery and business continuity planning.
* Develop automation scripts using Bash, Python, or Ansible.

* Support virtualization and cloud-hosted Linux workloads across VMware, Hyper-V, AWS, Azure, or GCP.

The IBM CP4I OpenShift Operations/Administrator is a systems infrastructure specialist responsible for designing, deploying, securing, and maintaining our enterprise hybrid-cloud integration architecture. **مهندس شبكات – Network Engineer**

نبحث عن مهندس شبكات لديه خبرة جيدة في تصميم وتنفيذ وتشغيل وصيانة الشبكات والبنية التحتية التقنية.

**المهام والمسؤوليات:**

* تصميم وتنفيذ شبكات LAN / WAN.
* تركيب وإعداد السويتشات والراوترات وأجهزة الشبكة.
* إعداد VLANs, Routing, Switching, STP, DHCP وVPN.
* متابعة أداء الشبكة ومعالجة الأعطال والمشاكل الفنية.
* تنفيذ أعمال Structured Cabling والـFiber ومتابعة الاختبارات.
* إعداد وتوثيق مخططات الشبكة وNetwork Diagrams.
* التنسيق مع الموردين والمصنعين فيما يخص الحلول الفنية والمشاريع.
* إعداد التقارير الفنية ودعم فرق المشاريع.
* تنفيذ اختبارات الشبكة والتأكد من جاهزيتها قبل التسليم.
* الالتزام بمتطلبات الأمن السيبراني وسياسات الشبكة.

**المتطلبات:**

* بكالوريوس في هندسة الشبكات، تقنية المعلومات، علوم الحاسب أو تخصص ذي صلة.
* خبرة عملية في مجال الشبكات.
* معرفة جيدة بتقنيات Cisco وFortinet وAruba أو ما يعادلها.
* خبرة في Switching, Routing, Firewalls وWireless Networks.
* يفضل وجود شهادات مهنية مثل **CCNA / CCNP / Fortinet NSE أو ما يعادلها**.
* القدرة على قراءة المخططات والمواصفات الفنية.
* إجادة اللغة الإنجليزية بشكل جيد.
* مهارات جيدة في حل المشكلات والعمل ضمن فريق.

**نوع الوظيفة:** دوام كامل

job_description:
We are seeking a skilled CAD Operator to support the delivery of a major transport infrastructure and utilities supervision project in King Abdullah Economic City (KAEC). The ideal candidate will have dominant and extensive experience in transport infrastructure and utility projects and be proficient in preparing and updating engineering drawings in coordination with multidisciplinary teams.

  

The CAD Operator will be responsible for the preparation, modification and management of engineering drawings related to roads, utilities and infrastructure works. The role requires strong experience in transport infrastructure projects involving dry and wet utility networks, ensuring drawings are produced and maintained in accordance with project standards and client requirements.

* Prepare, revise and maintain CAD drawings for roads, utilities and infrastructure works.
* Develop and update shop drawing records, as-built drawings and construction documentation.
* Coordinate with engineers, inspectors and project teams to incorporate design and site changes.
* Ensure compliance with project drafting standards, procedures and quality requirements.
* Maintain drawing registers and document control processes.
* Support multidisciplinary coordination across utility and roadway packages.
* Review contractor-submitted CAD drawings for completeness and accuracy.
* Generate plan, profile, cross-section and utility layout drawings.

  

* Diploma or Degree in Civil Engineering, Drafting Technology or related discipline.
* Minimum 5+ years of CAD drafting experience.
* Dominant and extensive experience on transport infrastructure and utilities projects.
* Strong experience with roadway, stormwater, sewerage, water supply, power, telecom and utility corridor drawings.
* Proficient in AutoCAD and Civil 3D.
* Experience working on large-scale infrastructure developments and supervision projects.
* GCC experience, preferably in Saudi Arabia.
* Strong attention to detail and coordination skills.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. Join WSP and be part of a team shaping the communities of tomorrow.

Role Description

Bemco Services Company is seeking a qualified **PLC, SCADA & Control Systems Specialist** for a full-time, on-site position in Jeddah.

The successful candidate will be responsible for programming, configuring, testing, commissioning, maintaining, and troubleshooting PLC, SCADA, HMI, and industrial control systems. **Job Purpose**

The Control & Automation Engineer is responsible for the design, operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, testing, and optimization of industrial control and automation systems. The role ensures reliable and safe operation of PLC, SCADA, BMS, DCS, instrumentation, control panels, and associated electrical systems, while supporting preventive and corrective maintenance activities.

Responsibilities

* Maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize PLC, SCADA, HMI, DCS, and automation systems.
* Diagnose control-system faults and perform corrective actions to minimize equipment downtime.
* Develop, modify, and troubleshoot PLC programs, control logic, sequences, and HMI interfaces.
* Perform preventive and corrective maintenance for automation and control equipment.
* Maintain and troubleshoot sensors, transmitters, actuators, control valves, relays, VFDs, and instrumentation.
* Review electrical and control drawings, including: Control schematics, Wiring diagrams, Single-line diagrams, I/O lists, Instrumentation drawings, Cause & Effect diagrams.
* Perform testing and commissioning of automation and control systems.
* Participate in system upgrades, modifications, and new automation projects.
* Coordinate with electrical, mechanical, IT, and other engineering teams during troubleshooting and project execution.
* Monitor system performance and identify opportunities for automation improvement and energy optimization.
* Maintain accurate records of PM/CM activities, breakdowns, modifications, and system parameters.
* Support contractors and vendors during installation, commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Ensure automation systems comply with applicable safety, engineering, and company standards/procedures.
* Prepare technical, maintenance, and test reports, and equipment documentation.
* Maintain backups of PLC programs, HMI applications, configurations, and critical automation data.
* Support SCADA/BMS integration and communication networks, including industrial communication protocols.
* Participate in emergency and breakdown response activities when required.

  
**Requirements**

**Education requirements:** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.

**Certification Requirements:** Knowledge of IEC, NFPA, ISA, and other applicable standards.

**Experience:** 1-2 years in industrial automation, electrical systems, instrumentation, or maintenance.

Job Summary

The Road Network Engineer is responsible for the planning, design, operation, and maintenance assessment of road networks within urban developments, communities, cities, and large-scale infrastructure projects. The role focuses on enhancing connectivity, traffic flow, road safety, and transportation efficiency through engineering analysis, design reviews, and performance monitoring.

* Develop road network strategies and transportation infrastructure plans.
* Review and evaluate road layouts, alignments, intersections, and access points.
* Ensure road designs comply with local and international engineering standards.
* Assess road hierarchy, connectivity, and capacity requirements for current and future demand.
* Support master planning activities and infrastructure integration.

* Conduct traffic studies, transportation assessments, and capacity analyses.
* Analyze traffic volumes, flow patterns, congestion points, and network performance.
* Identify bottlenecks and recommend infrastructure improvements.
* Support transportation demand management initiatives.
* Evaluate road network performance using simulation and modeling tools.

* Identify safety risks, accident-prone locations, and operational deficiencies.

* Support initiatives related to sustainable transportation and future mobility.

### **Description**

**A Career with Trivandi**

Working for Trivandi means the opportunity to work on the world’s most iconic projects in a supportive, people-first environment with colleagues who are passionate, collaborative and love what they do.

Our culture is grounded in trust and fulfilment, with a shared passion for achieving excellence, whilst having fun. We’re dedicated to ensuring that every team member’s voice is heard and valued, enabling Trivandi to be shaped and grown by the people within it.

Ultimately, Trivandi is a place where you’ll be excited to come to work at the start of each week.

Together, we keep our shared values at the heart of everything we do:

* **Passion**: We love what we do and care passionately about achieving great outcomes with our partners.

  

* **Trust & Quality:** We are trusted to consistently deliver to the highest international standards and professional ethics.

  

* **OneTeam**: We are a close-knit team and know that our best work is done together. We care for each other, always putting people first, enabling us to deliver our best work.

  

* **Always Evolving**: We don't stand still. We strive to make each project better than the last, daring to challenge what's gone before, in our quest for innovation and improvement.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

NO CYBERSECURITY, READ DESCRIPTION  
  
Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.  
  
Amazon's data centers house the infrastructure that powers the world's largest cloud. Protecting them is mission-critical — and as a Security Specialist Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will help ensure the physical security of these facilities from the inside.  
  
You will drive operational security excellence, write reports, create presentations, and communicate with management on the status of physical security operations. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.  
  
This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Security Specialist position, subject to available roles and business needs.  
  
Who Should Apply  
  
We welcome applications from:  
  

* Students in the last year of their Technical/Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Security Management, Criminology, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

  
It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.  
  
About the Role  
  
As a Security Specialist Intern, you will work within the Data Center Security team and play a hands-on role in the day-to-day physical security operations of Amazon's data centers. You will collaborate with security vendors, analyze operational data, and help identify improvements to surveillance systems, access controls, and security procedures.  
  
This is not a desk-only role. You will engage directly with the people, systems, and processes that keep Amazon's most critical infrastructure safe.  
  
What You Will Do  

* Coordinate with vendors involved in new security construction, repairs, daily security operations and patrols, and planning.
* Analyze security metrics and data to identify trends and recommend improvements
* Make suggestions on improving electronic surveillance systems and access controls
* Help develop and deliver guidance to data center occupants on reducing false alarms
* Write reports and create presentations on the status of physical security operations

Who Are We❓

Step into the world of Mrsool—where convenience meets innovation! As one of the largest delivery platforms in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, Mrsool has captivated users with its unique and seamless experience, earning it the highest ratings among all major delivery platforms on both Apple's App Store and Google's Play Store.

What sets Mrsool apart is its commitment to providing an unmatched "order anything from anywhere" experience. Using Generative AI, we analyze customer instructions in real-time and search across 100,000+ restaurants and stores to find exactly what they need. Our cutting-edge technology, combined with a vast fleet of dedicated on-demand couriers, ensures fast and reliable delivery—no matter how far or remote the location may be.

But don’t just take our word for it—Mrsool is consistently rated among the highest of all major delivery platforms, earning top reviews on both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. Our commitment to a flawless, personalized experience has earned the trust of millions across the region, making Mrsool the go-to delivery app for a generation that demands both convenience and excellence.

Whether it's a late-night craving, a forgotten item, or a special gift for a loved one, Mrsool is here to deliver, quite literally. We take pride in the convenience we offer, empowering you to get what you need when you need it, all at the tap of a button.

The Job in a Nutshell

We’re looking for a **Part-Time Logistics Operations Specialist** to support LAAS’s daily operations and ensure orders are followed up smoothly from assignment to final delivery or return.

This role requires someone who is organized, responsive, and comfortable coordinating with multiple parties including drivers, merchants, and customers.

**Working Hours:** 4 hours per day + 30-minute break

What You Will Do

* Monitor and follow up on daily orders to ensure smooth and timely delivery.
* Coordinate with drivers and merchants regarding order status, delays, and operational issues.
* Track delayed or problematic orders and follow up until they are resolved.
* Contact customers when needed to confirm successful delivery or coordinate order returns.
* Coordinate the return of unsuccessful or cancelled orders to merchants.
* Update order statuses accurately in the system.
* Handle order assignment and reassignment when required.
* Follow up with drivers and operational teams through WhatsApp groups.
* Escalate unresolved

***What will you do?***

  
  
  

**Safety Policy and Objectives:**

  

* Support the implementation, maintenance and improvement of KONE safety management system (operating model) including worker, user and third-party safety.

* Compile, maintain and improve safety documentation together with the unit safety team.
* Actively participate in and contribute to unit safety committee and other safety forums.
* Provide professional advice and support to the unit on matters affecting safety.
* Plan, participate in and implement projects and activities to improve safety.
* Work closely with customers and partners, including KONE subcontractors.
Support the development, review and exercise of crisis and emergency response plans.  

  

**Safety Risk Management:**

  
  

* Monitor and develop safety risk management processes, tools and practices.
Support safety related change management projects and initiatives.  

  

**Safety Assurance:**

* Collect, measure and ensure accuracy of leading and lagging safety data. Report performance.
* Monitor legal and business environment development in safety, identify and propose actions.
* Perform safety audits regularly to verify compliance, identify uncontrolled risks and deviations.
* Assist line management in safety audits/visits and support the audit process improvement.
* Analyze and investigate incidents. Support the investigation process improvement.
Manage corrective and preventive actions for continual improvement.

**Our Company**
---------------

Technogym inspires **70 million daily users** to train using our **innovative & engaging solutions for fitness, sport and health**. Suppose you are a team player with strong relationship skills and an international approach, eager to invest your energy in building dreams. • Maintain and properly update the A/R statement, including due dates, payment methods and litigation • Establish close relations

Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services. We create and operate intelligent infrastructures and buildings that respond to the climate emergency and contribute to more balanced, sustainable and resilient territorial development. Operating in 77 countries, Egis puts the expertise of its 23,500 employees at the service of its clients and develops cutting-edge innovations accessible to all projects. Through its wide range of activities, Egis is a key player in the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.

With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis has long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is seeking an experienced **Quality Auditor and Training Specialist** to support quality assurance, compliance auditing, training management, and continuous improvement activities for a major Airport, Infrastructure, and Airfield Development Project.

The successful candidate will be responsible for planning and conducting audits, monitoring compliance with project requirements, developing and delivering training programs, and supporting the implementation of quality, safety, and operational improvement initiatives across the project.

The Auditor and Training Specialist will work closely with Project Quality, HSE, Construction, Engineering, Contractors, Consultants, and Airport Stakeholders to ensure project teams are aligned with approved procedures, international standards, and client expectations.

* Conduct internal and external audits across project teams, contractors, consultants, and suppliers.
* Verify compliance with:
  + Project procedures.
  + Quality Management Plans.
  + HSE requirements.
  + Contract requirements.
  + International standards and client expectations.
* Document audit findings and monitor corrective action implementation.

* Perform audits across major airport project activities including:
  + Passenger terminals.
  + Runways and taxiways.
  + Cargo aprons.
  + Aircraft stands.
  + External infrastructure.
  + Utilities.
  + MEP systems.
  + ICT and specialist airport systems.

  + Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs).
  + Method statements.
  + Work procedures.
  + Quality documentation.
*

**Job Description**

**Contract:** Permanent

**Team:** Fragomen Knowledge Group, Learning & Advisory Hub

**Office Location:** Saudi Arabia – Riyadh or Al Khobar

  

**The role**

The Senior Learning & Advisory Specialist will contribute to the delivery and continued development of knowledge management, business advisory and government advisory work across the MENA region. This role will involve delivering consulting and advisory services and facilitating both internal and external knowledge-sharing sessions.

  

The role covers the entire Middle East and North Africa region. You will work closely with Subject Matter Experts across Fragomen to obtain, provide and validate information, particularly in relation to the practical implementation of immigration, labour and other relevant regulations. You will also collaborate with other internal teams, external stakeholders and, where appropriate, government authorities to ensure that the information and advice provided by the firm is accurate, practical and timely.

  

In addition to knowledge management responsibilities, you will draft thought-leadership and other content, contribute to business and government advisory projects, support business development and marketing initiatives, and represent the team at selected conferences, meetings and other external engagements. The role will also include administrative responsibilities associated with the effective operation of the team.

  

**What your day will look like**

* Draft, edit, update and publish content on immigration, mobility and other areas of regional regulatory framework and practice.

* Research applicable regulatory frameworks and monitor legislative, policy and procedural developments across the MENA region.

* Work closely with Subject Matter Experts to obtain, provide and validate information, particularly regarding the practical implementation of regulatory requirements and government processes.

* Conduct regular quality-control reviews of content, products and processes to maintain accuracy, consistency and operational efficiency.

* Conduct strategic analysis of regulatory frameworks across the MENA region, including preparing international benchmarking studies, current-state assessments, topic-specific reports, policy papers and white papers.

* Contribute to business advisory projects, including compliance reviews and audits, policy drafting and review, multijurisdictional assessments, workforce mobility projects and client training.

Our client is investing in the effectiveness of its sanctions screening capability - and needs a hands-on FircoSoft

specialist to tune it. Working within the institution's financial crime compliance function in Riyadh - with candidates

welcomed from anywhere in the world, and relocation and mobilisation fully supported - you will assess, calibrate and

optimise the FircoSoft screening environment across customer and payment screening: filter rules, matching

algorithms, thresholds, list management and workflow configuration.

Arabic fluency is central to the role, not incidental to it. Screening effectiveness in the Saudi market depends on how

the filter handles Arabic names - transliteration variants, romanisation schemes, name particles, honorifics and

orthographic differences between Arabic-script and Latin-script records. You will bring both the platform expertise to

tune the engine and the linguistic judgement to know when a match rule is generating noise and when it is masking

risk.

 **Requirements**

Assess the current FircoSoft configuration - matching algorithms, rules, thresholds, good-guy/exception lists, and

screening scope across customer and transaction/payment screening.

* Tune filter parameters and matching logic to reduce false positives without compromising sanctions risk coverage,

with documented pre- and post-tuning analysis.

* Optimise Arabic name-matching performance: transliteration handling, romanisation variants, name particles and

script-conversion behaviour across watchlists and customer data.

* Review list management - sanctions list ingestion, versioning and update mechanisms (UN, OFAC, EU, UK and

local/SAMA-directed lists) - and the governance around exceptions and whitelisting.

* Conduct above-the-line/below-the-line style effectiveness testing of screening outcomes; document methodology,

results and recommendations to withstand model validation and regulatory challenge.

* Support alert workflow and operating model improvements - alert quality, hibernation/suppression logic, escalation

paths and investigator feedback loops.

* Coordinate with Compliance, Screening Operations, Technology and the vendor; present findings and

recommendations to senior stakeholders in Arabic and English as required.

Essential

* Hands-on FircoSoft tuning experience - filter configuration, matching algorithms, rules and threshold calibration (not

oversight of a team that did it).

* Professional fluency in Arabic and English,

Job Purpose:

Support and governs cloud financial management practices to ensure cloud spending is transparent, controlled, and aligned with organizational financial objectives.

The role enables cost visibility, budgeting, forecasting, and optimization by providing reporting, cost allocation mechanisms, and advisory to application teams, platform engineering, and cloud operations teams to improve cost efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

* Support and maintain cloud cost governance policies, financial guardrails, and usage controls to ensure responsible cloud consumption across teams.
* Configure and manage cloud budget alerts to monitor spending and notify stakeholders when consumption approaches defined thresholds.
* Publish and maintain cloud cost dashboards and reports to provide visibility into cloud spend, consumption trends, and cost drivers.
* Support cloud cost budgeting and forecasting based on historical usage patterns, growth projections, and planned cloud adoption initiatives.
* Implement and maintain cloud cost allocation and showback mechanisms to attribute cloud spending to assets, departments and applications.
* Analyze cloud usage patterns and identify opportunities to optimize resource consumption and reduce unnecessary spend.
* Provide cost optimization recommendations to application teams (FITB/ FITB-A) and cloud operations team to improve efficiency of cloud resource usage.
* Evaluate and recommend commitment-based pricing options such as Committed Use Discounts (CUDs) based on workload usage patterns.
* Support the purchase and lifecycle management of commitment-based discounts to maximize cost efficiency and financial predictability.
* Work with cloud platform engineering and cloud operations teams to enforce cost governance controls and improve cost visibility through tagging.
* Maintain documentation and financial governance artifacts related to cloud cost management policies, reports, and optimization practices.

Support annual departmental financial planning and budgeting activities.

**Job Title:** Field Technical Support Specialist

**Company:** Entreprendre Education Tech

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Summary:**

Entreprendre Education Tech is looking for a proactive Field Technical Support Specialist to provide on-site technical installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting for educational hardware, interactive learning displays, classroom software, and school network infrastructure across client partner institutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Deploy, assemble, and configure educational hardware, interactive flat panels, projectors, smart boards, and classroom IT devices.
* Conduct on-site diagnostics, repairs, and software updates for school computer labs, servers, and local network setups.
* Train educators and school IT staff on the proper operation and basic maintenance of installed educational technologies.
* Log, track, and resolve escalated technical support tickets within established service level agreements (SLAs).
* Inspect and test installed hardware and network connectivity to guarantee optimal daily classroom performance.
* Maintain detailed technical service logs, hardware inventory records, and field installation reports.

**Key Requirements:**

* **Education:** Degree or Diploma in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field.
* **Experience:** Minimum of 2–4 years of experience in field IT support, hardware deployment, or educational technology setup.
* **Skills:** Strong knowledge of Windows/OS deployment, local area networks (LAN/Wi-Fi troubleshooting), interactive displays, and AV systems.
* **Competencies:** Excellent customer service skills, clear technical communication, quick analytical problem-solving, and willingness to travel regularly to client locations.

For one of our clients, we are looking for an
**L1 Desktop Support Engineer**
to provide first-level technical support to end users across hardware, software, and basic infrastructure-related issues.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide first-line support for desktops, laptops, printers, and peripheral devices.
* Troubleshoot basic hardware, software, operating system, network, Wi-Fi, VPN, and printer issues.
* Support Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint.
* Assist with password resets, account unlocks, and user access-related issues.
* Provide remote support using approved remote assistance tools.
* Log, track, update, and resolve incidents and service requests through the ITSM tool.
* Monitor ticket queues and ensure compliance with SLA targets.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to L2/L3 support teams.
* Assist with laptop and desktop setup, deployment, refresh, and replacement activities.
* Maintain accurate asset inventory and device records.
* Support user onboarding and offboarding activities, including account setup, access provisioning, asset collection, and access removal.
* Perform basic Active Directory activities and coordinate with network, server, and application teams.
* Maintain clear documentation of troubleshooting activities and resolutions.
* Follow ITIL-based Incident, Request, and Change Management processes.
* Adhere to organizational security, compliance, and IT policies.

**Requirements**

* 2–5 years of experience in desktop support, service desk, or IT support.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

**Description**
We are looking for an IT Specialist to join our team at Holiday Inn Riyadh Rose Yard. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the hotel's daily IT operations by maintaining systems, networks, and technology infrastructure. The role ensures reliable technical support, system security, and efficient operation of hotel technology in line with IHG standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide first-line technical support for hardware, software, network, and system-related issues across all hotel departments.
* Maintain and monitor hotel systems including PMS, POS, email, internet, telephony, and other business applications.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot computers, printers, network devices, and other IT equipment.
* Monitor network performance, Wi-Fi connectivity, and system availability to minimize downtime.
* Perform routine system maintenance, software updates, backups, and antivirus management.
* Create and manage user accounts, passwords, and system access in accordance with hotel security policies.
* Maintain accurate records of IT assets, software licenses, maintenance logs, and support requests.
* Coordinate with external vendors and service providers for equipment repairs and system maintenance when required.
* Support IT projects, system upgrades, and technology implementations across the hotel.
* Ensure compliance with IHG IT policies, cybersecurity standards, and data protection requirements.
* Provide basic user training and guidance on hotel systems and IT best practices.
* Perform other IT-related duties as assigned by the IT Manager.

**Requirements**
:
  
  

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Minimum 2–4 years of IT support experience, preferably within the hospitality industry.
* Good knowledge of Windows operating systems, computer networks, Microsoft Office 365, and hotel applications.
* Experience with hotel systems such as Opera PMS, POS, and Active Directory is an advantage.
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Good organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

About the Company:

Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.

About the Role:

Are you ready to grow government revenue by building trusted partnerships and delivering standout support across a high-potential sales channel?

This role is central to expanding and protecting revenue across the government segment through the Ercab platform in partnership with Expro. It supports a fast-growing channel where strong engagement, service quality, and commercial focus directly influence performance.

With responsibility for an assigned portfolio of ministries and government entities, the role focuses on revenue growth, account development, and relationship management. A core part of the role is maintaining close contact with travel desks, procurement teams, and key decision makers across the Kingdom.

Working closely with Expro, this position delivers training workshops for government users on booking flows, fare and bundle rules, and the network and product offering. It also ensures user guides and reference materials stay accurate and relevant as the platform evolves.

You can expect to monitor daily production, identify revenue or service issues quickly, and coordinate effective resolutions. The role also supports platform content updates, escalations, and joint promotional activity that strengthens engagement and performance.

In addition, this position ensures activity aligns with government procurement and travel rules as well as our commercial policy. Clear reporting on segment performance will help shape priorities and support continued growth.

*This is your chance to build trusted government partnerships, strengthen a high-growth sales channel, and directly influence commercial momentum across the Kingdom.*

Degree qualified, you will demonstrate a minimum of 4 years of experience in sales or account management within an airline, travel management company, or travel agency environment.

You will bring strong experience managing government or public sector accounts, delivering user training, working with online booking platforms and government travel procurement processes, and using Excel and revenue data with professionalism, structure, and attention to detail.

job_description:
The House Hotel,
  
  
Jeddah
  
  
**About Kerten Hospitality**
Kerten Hospitality (KH) is an end-to-end lifestyle hospitality operator creating bespoke destinations, lodging, experiences and communities while optimising operations and driving profitability for savvy investors with a strong commitment to sustainability. KH transforms destinations through impactful partnerships with Lodging, Food & Beverage, Retail, Entertainment, Art and Wellness brands with a focus on building Ecosystems, and unique community-centric destinations, which connect International & local travelers. The Group’s current pipeline of lodging includes projects in numerous countries in the Middle East, Europe, and North Africa region. An expanding development pipeline of more than 55 lodging projects representing over 4,500 keys planned across our international development pipeline.
  
  
Our Impact
  
  
Every destination we develop and every concept we bring to life is driven by purpose and rooted in ESG, locality, sustainability, innovation, meaningful collaborations, that nurture ecosystems supporting community growth, guided by our values of
**Connection, Curation, Innovation, and Leading the Way**
.
  
  
**About The Property**
**The House Hotel Jeddah King Road**
Positioned along the energy of the Red Sea coastline, The House Hotel Jeddah is conceived as a contemporary urban escape — where coastal lifestyle meets modern hospitality.
  
  
With 129 carefully curated rooms, the property brings together comfort, design, and effortless living, anchored by a vibrant signature restaurant that acts as both a social hub and a culinary destination.
  
  
**Location:**

The Team:

We are an award winning global consultancy and have been named Building’s Engineering Consultant of the Year in 2024, 2022 and 2021. We are at the forefront of the industry, priding ourselves on our exemplary track record of designing innovative and sustainable projects.

Sustainability runs through everything we do at Cundall, and our people are empowered to drive change and decarbonise the built environment. By the end of this decade, we have set ourselves an ambitious goal to only work on projects that meet our zero carbon design criteria, a commitment we have called our Zero Carbon Design 2030 goal. We need engineers who share this passion for sustainability and thrive in designing energy efficient buildings and communities.

Cundall’s Structural Engineering team prides itself in their exemplary track record of designing innovative and sustainable structural solutions, that minimise the use of natural resources. As one of the longest established of Cundall’s many disciplines, the Structural team are a source of world leading expertise – and offer a pro-active and collaborative approach to skill development, and professional excellence.

The Role:

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with an experienced background in structural engineering to join our team at our office in Riyadh to work on the design of some of the most exciting structural design projects in KSA and regionally.

As part of our established team of expert engineers and CAD technicians, and working closely with colleagues of various disciplines, you will prepare detailed structural calculations for multiple materials and using appropriate software. You will work across a variety of sectors such as Education, Commercial, Healthcare, Retail and Critical Systems, and will have the opportunity over time to assume greater levels of responsibility and autonomy as your professional skills develop, and as you work and are supported towards Chartership.

The Skills:

Having already been accredited with a BEng degree level (or equivalent), you will have gained strong practical experience of structural engineering within a consultancy environment, and be proficient in the use of design and modelling software such as Etabs, Safe, SAP, Robot, Prokon, and IDEA StatiCa. You will be familiar with producing creative design solutions in multiple materials, including steel, reinforced concrete and masonry, and crucially - have a passion for creative and intuitive design.

job_description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

**Job Description:**

  
  

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Project Controls & Change Management Manager** to join our team! In this role, you will work closely with the Project Controls Director and management, engineering, procurement, construction, commercial, contracts, finance, and client representatives to assess the impact of changes and support informed project decision-making.

  
  

**What You'll Be Doing:**

### **Project Controls Management**

* Establish and implement project controls procedures, systems, tools, and reporting requirements.
* Develop and maintain the project control baseline, including scope, schedule, cost, resources, and key performance indicators.
* Oversee the preparation and maintenance of the integrated master schedule.
* Ensure that project budgets, commitments, actual costs, forecasts, and cash flows are accurately maintained.
* Monitor project performance against approved cost and schedule baselines.
* Review schedule updates, progress reports, cost reports, forecasts, and variance analyses.
* Ensure timely identification of trends, deviations, risks, and opportunities.
* Coordinate the preparation of monthly project performance reports and executive dashboards.
* Ensure consistent reporting across project teams, contractors, subcontractors, and other stakeholders.
* Lead the development of recovery plans for projects experiencing cost, schedule, or performance issues.
* Support earned value management, productivity analysis, resource planning, and performance measurement activities.
* Ensure project control data is accurate, complete, traceable, and suitable for management decision-making.

### **Change Management**

* Establish and administer the project change management and change control process.
* Manage the identification, registration, assessment, approval, implementation, and closeout of project changes.
* Maintain the project change register, trend register, potential change log, and associated records.
* Review change requests, change notices, variation orders, field instructions, design
