Nahil Computers, a leading IT system integrator in Saudi Arabia, is hiring a Backup & Storage Administrator for an enterprise project in the financial sector.

What you'll do:

- Administer enterprise backup platforms: policies, schedules, retention, daily job monitoring and failure resolution.

- Perform regular test restores and take part in DR drills and DR documentation.

- Manage Dell EMC storage: LUN/volume provisioning, snapshots, replication, firmware and health checks.

- Manage the SAN fabric: zoning and Brocade switch maintenance.

- Track storage and backup capacity and produce monthly capacity and performance reports.

- Handle incidents, service requests and changes per ITIL and the client's SLAs.

- Work with Dell and other vendors on support cases, upgrades and patching.

- Apply security controls (encryption, immutable/air-gapped copies, access reviews) and support audits (SAMA, NCA).

- Maintain runbooks, diagrams and asset inventory; take part in an on-call rotation.

What we're looking for:

- Around 10 years of hands-on backup and storage experience.

- Strong skills in at least one of Veeam, Commvault, NetBackup or Dell NetWorker/Data Domain.

- Dell EMC storage and data protection experience (PowerMax, PowerStore, Unity, Data Domain, NetWorker/PowerProtect) is a strong plus.

- SAN switching experience; banking or financial-sector experience and vendor certifications are a plus.

- Currently based in Saudi Arabia.

To apply, click Apply and complete our application form. Only applications submitted through the form will be considered.

job_description:
We are recruiting a Local Talent and Community Programming Manager to join a dedicated, full-time team embedded in our client’s Festival Programming function in Riyadh. The team will support two major events in Saudi Arabia: a flagship event in summer 2027 (July to August) and a further event in November 2027.

You will lead the festival’s local and regional programming, working alongside the international clubs and creators lead. You will bring in:

* Saudi and regional clubs
* Arabic-speaking creators
* Universities
* Grassroots and community tournaments
* Cultural and national moments

You will build this local content into the main programme rather than running it as a side show, so it feels like part of the festival from day one. You will also make sure all local content meets cultural and regulatory requirements.

This is a hands-on producing role. The grade reflects your seniority and judgement, not the size of a team you supervise. We are looking for a programmer who personally builds the local and regional programme.

**Key Responsibilities**

Local and Regional Programming

* Lead local and regional programming, including Saudi and regional clubs, creators, grassroots and community competitions, Arabic-language and cultural moments, and local talent.
* Build a prioritised list of local content opportunities from national moments, the host-city calendar and community activity.

Programme Integration

* Integrate local content with the international programme rather than running it alongside.
* Work with the international clubs and creators lead so that local and international content feel like one festival.

Partner Coordination

* Coordinate day to day with Saudi and regional clubs, creators, universities, grassroots organisations and agencies.
* Maintain the local partner log so every relationship and commitment is tracked.

Cultural and Regulatory Compliance

* Make sure all local content meets cultural and regulatory requirements.
* Flag and resolve compliance issues early in the planning process.

Audience Insight

* Capture local audience response to inform the programme across both events.

  
**Requirements**  

* At least 8 years of experience in gaming, esports, entertainment or major live events in Saudi Arabia or the region, at Senior Manager level.
* Experience across at least two live event seasons.
* A proven record of personally producing local and regional programming. Only experience where you personally produced the work counts

نبحث عن أخصائي تسويق بالذكاء الاصطناعي يمتلك خبرة في التسويق الرقمي وتوظيف تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي (AI) في تطوير الحملات التسويقية، وتحليل البيانات، وإنشاء المحتوى الإبداعي، وتحسين الأداء التسويقي، بما يسهم في تعزيز الوعي بالعلامة التجارية، وزيادة العملاء المحتملين، وتحقيق المستهدفات التسويقية بكفاءة وابتكار.

المهام والمسؤوليات

* توظيف أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي في تخطيط وتنفيذ الحملات التسويقية الرقمية وتحسين نتائجها.
* إعداد وتطوير المحتوى التسويقي الإبداعي باستخدام أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي، بما يشمل النصوص والصور والفيديوهات.
* إدارة وتحسين الحملات الإعلانية عبر منصات Google Ads وMeta Ads وLinkedIn.
* تحليل بيانات الحملات التسويقية وقياس مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية (KPIs)، وتقديم التوصيات لتحسين النتائج.
* استخدام أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي في تحليل سلوك العملاء وتحديد الشرائح المستهدفة وتحسين تجربة العملاء.
* تطوير استراتيجيات التسويق بالمحتوى وتحسين محركات البحث (SEO).
* أتمتة العمليات التسويقية المتكررة باستخدام أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي والتسويق الآلي.
* متابعة أحدث التقنيات والاتجاهات في الذكاء الاصطناعي والتسويق الرقمي وتطبيق الحلول المناسبة.
* التنسيق مع فرق المبيعات والتصميم وتطوير الأعمال لتحقيق الأهداف المشتركة.
* إعداد التقارير الدورية حول أداء الحملات، ومعدلات التحويل، وتكلفة اكتساب العملاء.

المؤهلات العلمية

* درجة البكالوريوس في التسويق أو التسويق الرقمي أو تقنية المعلومات أو تخصص ذي صلة.
* يفضل الحصول على دورات أو شهادات احترافية في التسويق الرقمي أو الذكاء الاصطناعي.

الخبرات المطلوبة

* خبرة من 3 إلى 5 سنوات في التسويق الرقمي أو التسويق المدعوم بالذكاء الاصطناعي.
* خبرة عملية في استخدام أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي لإنتاج المحتوى وتحليل البيانات وتحسين الحملات.
* خبرة في إدارة الحملات الإعلانية وقياس الأداء وتحسين معدلات التحويل.
* يفضل وجود خبرة في القطاع العقاري والتسويق للمشاريع والمنتجات العقارية.

المهارات التقنية

* إتقان أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي مثل ChatGPT وClaude وGemini.
* معرفة بأدوات إنشاء التصاميم والمحتوى المرئي مثل Canva AI وAdobe Firefly وأدوات إنتاج الفيديو بالذكاء الاصطناعي.
* إجادة استخدام Google Analytics 4 وGoogle Ads وMeta Ads Manager.
* معرفة بأدوات تحسين محركات البحث وتحليل الكلمات المفتاحية.
* القدرة على استخدام أدوات الأتمتة التسويقية مثل Zapier أو Make.
* إجادة إعداد التقارير ولوحات قياس الأداء باستخدام Excel أو Power BI، ويفضل الإلمام بأنظمة CRM.

المهارات الشخصية

* التفكير التحليلي والإبداعي وحل المشكلات.
* القدرة على الابتكار وتطوير أفكار تسويقية جديدة.
* مهارات التواصل والعمل الجماعي وإدارة الوقت.
* القدرة على مواكبة التقنيات الحديثة والتعلم المستمر.
* الاهتمام بالدقة وجودة المحتوى والالتزام بهوية العلامة التجارية.

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. **Job Purpose**

We are seeking experienced Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials Consultant to support and lead Oracle Financials implementation, enhancement, transformation, and support projects across enterprise clients. The successful candidates will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Business, and Technology stakeholders to design, configure, implement, test, and support Oracle Fusion Financials solutions while ensuring compliance with business requirements, financial controls, and local regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct discovery workshops and gather business and finance requirements from stakeholders.
* Analyze current-state and target-state finance processes and recommend Oracle Fusion best-practice solutions.
* Configure and support Oracle Fusion Financials modules including:
* General Ledger (GL)
* Accounts Payable (AP)
* Accounts Receivable (AR)
* Cash Management (CM)
* Fixed Assets (FA)
* Subledger Accounting (SLA)
* Design and configure enterprise structures, ledgers, legal entities, business units, charts of accounts, accounting calendars, currencies, and accounting rules.
* Prepare functional design documents, configuration workbooks, solution designs, process flows, fit-gap analyses, and decision logs.
* Support integrations, reporting, data migration, data validation, reconciliation, and conversion activities.
* Coordinate with technical, integration, reporting, ERP, and data teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.
* Prepare and execute SIT, UAT, reconciliation testing, defect management, and business sign-off activities.
* Support month-end and year-end financial close processes.
* Deliver user training, knowledge transfer sessions, operational readiness activities, and training materials.
* Support cutover planning, opening balance validation, go-live, hypercare, and transition to support.
* Prepare project status updates and proactively manage risks, issues, dependencies, and scope considerations.
* Mentor junior consultants and review project deliverables where applicable.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* Oracle Financials Cloud Certifications.
* Professional accounting certifications such as SOCPA, CPA, CMA, ACCA.

**Minimum Experience.**

* 5+ years of Oracle ERP Functional consulting experience.
* Hands-on experience implementing or supporting Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials.

**Job Description**
Why This Role Matters
  
  
This role leads the design, modeling, and evolution of enterprise data architecture to ensure data products, curated layers, and integration patterns are standardized, scalable, high-quality, and governed. It defines how operational and corporate data should be modeled, aligned, and transformed to support analytics, reporting, AI enablement, and trusted downstream consumption across business domains.
  
  
What You Will Deliver
  
  
Lead Enterprise Data Modeling
  
  
Develop and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models aligned with enterprise business domains and data architecture principles.
  
  
Define canonical models, conformed dimensions, master/reference data structures, and reusable modeling patterns for cross-domain consistency.
  
  
Design data product models and curated layer schemas that support enterprise reporting, analytics, AI use cases, and downstream integrations.
  
  
Ensure models address performance, maintainability, scalability, auditability, lineage, and future reuse across platforms and domains.
  
  
Define Architecture Standards and Governance
  
  
Establish enterprise modeling standards, naming conventions, modeling guidelines, reusable templates, and quality expectations for delivery teams.
  
  
Partner with data governance teams to align business glossary definitions, stewardship ownership, metadata, lineage, and critical data elements.
  
  
Embed governance-by-design into data models, curated layers, transformation logic, data quality controls, and consumption patterns.
  
  
Review and approve modeling deliverables from internal teams and external vendors to ensure architectural consistency and quality.
  
  
Shape Data Product and Curated Layer Architecture
  
  
Lead the creation and optimization of data product schemas, curated layers, semantic structures, and consumption-ready models.
  
  
Define modeling approaches for relational, non-relational, time-series, streaming, lakehouse, warehouse, and analytical platform requirements.
  
  
Ensure data models support time-variant structures, historical traceability, auditability, semantic consistency, and trusted analytics consumption.
  
  
Coordinate with data engineering, platform, analytics, AI, and enterprise architecture teams to ensure models are technically feasible and reusable.

At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.
  
  
Our prevention-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.

job_description:
**Overview**  

KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end-to-end services to take clients from inspiration – through conceptualization – to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 60 years we’ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world’s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities.

  

As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey.

  

We invite you to join us. Why?

  

When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company-wide health and well-being through on-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards.

  
   
**Responsibilities**  

We envisage success in this role to include;

  

* Evaluate and approve **material submittals** for ELV and ICT systems, including Fire & Life Safety systems, BMS, Data Centers, OSP networks, Fiber Optic cabling (passive & active components), and intelligent unified platform installations.
* Review and provide detailed feedback on **shop drawings** related to ELV and ICT systems.
* Oversee and ensure the correct **installation, implementation, testing, and commissioning** of ELV/ICT systems across the project.
* Provide **technical guidance and supervision** to installation and site teams to ensure adherence to project specifications and international standards.
* Demonstrate deep technical expertise across ICT systems, including Fire & Security, BMS, Data Centers, OSP, Fiber Optics, and integrated smart building platforms.
* Coordinate closely with project teams to ensure **timely delivery** and alignment with project objective

job_description:
This position is for building, deploying and evaluating Client's Arabic AI tutor for mathematics and computer science: preparing Arabic training data, fine-tuning, aligning and evaluating LLMs on Shaheen III and Ibex, and integrating the tutor into the learning platform for a pilot in at least 10 Saudi schools.

The position is part of the RDIA-funded project 5870, "An AI-Powered Arabic Tutoring Platform for STEM Education in the Kingdom." Two engineers will be hired into this role.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare Arabic training datasets from educational materials and consented platform interactions.
* Fine-tune, align, and evaluate commercial and open-source LLMs using Shaheen III and Ibex computing platforms.
* Develop Arabic STEM benchmarks, preference-training methods, and student-safety guardrails.
* Integrate AI tutoring capabilities into the learning platform, including Arabic right-to-left interfaces.
* Deploy and optimize models for reliable, low-latency real-time interactions.
* Support school pilot implementation, evaluation, and teacher feedback collection.
* Ensure student data privacy and compliance with Saudi data protection requirements.
* Contribute to research publications, technical reports, and project deliverables.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* MSc in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field; alternatively, a BSc with at least one year of relevant experience.
* Hands-on experience in LLM fine-tuning, evaluation, and AI application deployment.
* Professional proficiency in Arabic and English.
* Experience with RLHF/DPO, educational technology, or mathematics/programming education is preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced Python and PyTorch.
* Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, and TRL.
* Distributed GPU training using DeepSpeed or FSDP.
* LLM evaluation, reward modeling, and preference optimization.
* Arabic NLP, data pipelines, and OCR.
* Model serving and inference optimization using tools such as vLLM.
* APIs, Docker, Git, CI/CD, and production deployment.

**Title:**

Risk Analyst

**1.1 Purpose:**
----------------

To support the implementation and maintenance of project and enterprise risk management (ERM) processes across engineering and project delivery assignments. The Risk Analyst is responsible for maintaining project risk registers, facilitating risk identification and assessment activities, monitoring mitigation actions, and providing accurate risk reporting to support informed decision-making and successful project delivery.

**1.2 Key Responsibilities:**
-----------------------------

* Support the implementation of project and enterprise risk management processes across assigned projects.
* Maintain and update project risk and opportunity registers, ensuring information remains accurate, current, and auditable.
* Assist in facilitating risk identification workshops and risk review meetings with project teams and stakeholders.
* Develop structured risk statements and support qualitative risk assessments using approved methodologies.
* Monitor risk mitigation actions and follow up with risk owners to ensure timely closure of actions.
* Track emerging risks and opportunities throughout the project lifecycle and escalate significant issues where required.
* Support the evaluation of schedule, cost, technical, commercial, procurement, and execution risks.
* Prepare risk reports, dashboards, heat maps, and management presentations.
* Coordinate risk data collection and maintain consistency across risk management systems and reporting tools.
* Support Project Managers, Project Controls, Engineering Leads, and Commercial teams in risk-related activities.
* Assist with contingency planning and the development of mitigation strategies.
* Ensure risk management activities align with project governance requirements and company procedures.
* Support lessons learned reviews and ensure risk-related knowledge is captured for future projects.

**1.3 Deliverables:**
---------------------

* Project Risk Registers
* Opportunity Registers
* Risk Action and Mitigation Tracking Logs
* Monthly Risk Reports and Dashboards
* Risk Heat Maps and Risk Matrices
* Risk Workshop Records and Action Logs
* Management Risk Review Presentations
* Emerging Risk Reports
* Lessons Learned and Risk Closure Reports
* Project Risk Status Updates for Gov

================================

Riyadh, Saudi Arabia · Full-time · Frontier

---------------------

Echelon is a Saudi-born, sovereign technology company that brings leading global AI technologies to the Kingdom and the world, deploys them through its own forward deployed operations, and productizes Saudi-developed capability.

job_description:
We're looking for a Tech Principal to lead technical strategy and execution on our most ambitious product work: lighthouse projects inside Thoughtworks' global Customer Experience, Product and Design team.
  
  
Here's the shape of it. A client arrives with a big idea and not much time. Within a few days, you've helped them turn it into a concept everyone agrees on. Within a few weeks, there's something real that customers can actually use and react to. Within a quarter, it's live. Then you do it again, somewhere else in the world, with a different team, and you leave both of them better at it than they were before.
  
  
If you have built a career integrating strategy, architecture, AI engineering, and executive collaboration, this role offers an ideal platform to leverage those skills.
  
  
The approach you'd be leading: We call it
**3/3/3**
**3 days:**
Product concept. Everyone aligned on scope, objectives and how we'll measure success.
  
  
**3 weeks:**
Working prototype. Desirability, viability and feasibility tested with real users.
  
  
**3 months:**
MLP launch. A production-grade minimum lovable product, ready to keep evolving.
  
  
Think of it as a reference tempo rather than a fixed schedule. The sequence is what we believe in: align quickly, get real evidence early, put something usable in front of customers while the idea is still current. A regulated platform with a heavy integration surface won't run like a greenfield mobile app, and reading the difference is part of the job.
  
  
AI runs through all of it, and not as a feature we add at the end. We use AI across the whole lifecycle, from specification and design through build, test and operations, and you'd be one of the people defining what good looks like there.
  
  
**Who You'd Work With**
We work in tight forward-deployed pods: one Product Strategist, one Experience Designer, and two Forward-Deployed Engineers. You're one of the FDEs — the lead engineer on the pod — guiding architecture, delivery cadence, and technical commercial choices, while collaborating with the strategist and designer as equal partners rather than a downstream requirements queue. Some of the best moments in this job happen when team members explore a challenge from complementary perspectives and unlock innovative solutions.

job_description:
**Job Summary**

Responsible for the administration, performance, availability, security, maintenance, upgrade, backup, recovery, and lifecycle management of enterprise Teradata database environments. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in Teradata database administration, performance monitoring and tuning, workload management, production support, migration, disaster recovery, and Teradata platform maintenance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Teradata Database Administration**

* Administer and support enterprise Teradata database environments across Production, UAT, Development, and DR systems.
* Perform Teradata database administration, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Manage Teradata users, roles, profiles, privileges, spool space, permanent space, and temporary space.
* Create and manage Teradata database objects including databases, tables, views, indexes, statistics, and partitions.
* Monitor database health, availability, system resources, space utilization, and operational performance.
* Troubleshoot database-related issues and perform root-cause analysis.

**2. Teradata Performance Monitoring & Tuning**

* Monitor Teradata system and query performance using Teradata Viewpoint, DBQL, and PDCR.
* Identify and analyze high CPU, high I/O, long-running, inefficient, and resource-intensive queries.
* Analyze query execution plans and identify performance bottlenecks.
* Analyze full-table scans, joins, indexes, statistics, partitioning, data distribution, and query access paths.
* Provide SQL and database performance tuning recommendations.
* Work with ETL and application teams to optimize poorly performing queries and database processes.
* Analyze historical workload information using DBQL and PDCR for performance investigation and reporting.

**3. PDCR & Teradata Viewpoint**

* Configure, install, and administer Teradata Performance & Data Collection (PDCR).
* Generate and maintain PDCR performance and management reports.
* Analyze historical database performance and workload information using PDCR.
* Configure and maintain Teradata Viewpoint portlets for database monitoring.
* Configure Query Spotlight and other monitoring capabilities to identify high CPU, high I/O, long-running, and problematic queries.
* Configure Viewpoint alerts for critical database conditions such as high space utilization, blocking sessions, and ETL-window performance issues.
* Develop and maintain customized Teradata performance and operational report

job_description:
**Job Summary**

The Senior Cloud FinOps Engineer owns CNTXT's financial exposure as a Google Cloud reseller, where CNTXT carries the bill for customer consumption while the controls sit inside customer workloads. The role builds and operates the billing-data platform that reduces consumption visibility from up to 72 hours (with full visibility only at month-end invoicing) to hours, and runs the control process on top of it: daily consumption monitoring, compromised-account response, enforcement under an agreed runbook, and Google-facing claims. The function follows standard centralized FinOps practice and forms the control layer CNTXT will reuse as it expands to multi-cloud.

**Scope**

* Covers all CNTXT Google Cloud billing IDs, online and offline, across the reseller customer base, and extends to additional clouds as CNTXT expands multi-cloud.
* Individual contributor; provides functional guidance to the Billing Operations Analyst on the daily watch and builds the case for Phase 2 hires.
* Executes enforcement actions (alert, cap, suspension, reactivation) within agreed mandates and the runbook's authority ladder, with approval steps for actions beyond mandate.
* Owns the tooling roadmap and budget for the function.
* Reports exposure, incidents and recoveries to the EMT monthly.

**Principal Contacts**

* Billing Operations Analyst (daily): guide the daily consumption watch and case triage.
* Finance (regular): align on reconciliation, exposure reporting and collections.
* Cybersecurity / GRC (regular): align on policy, risk appetite, Security Command Center adoption and the onboarding due-diligence gate.
* Sales and Customer Success (regular): coordinate customer communication on incidents and enforcement.
* Legal (occasional): advise on cap clauses in customer terms and back-to-back liability in partner agreements.
* EMT (monthly): report exposure, incidents and recoveries.
* Google partner and abuse teams (per incident): negotiate credit claims, handle abuse reports and escalate alerting issues.
* Customers (per incident): issue notices and coordinate containment and recovery.

**Principal Duties & Detailed Job Description**

1. **Billing Data Platform & Visibility (25%):**
   Build and operate the billing-data pipelines and dashboards that give near-real-time consumption visibility across all billing IDs.
2. **Anomaly Detection & Monitoring (20%):**
   Implement and tune anomaly detection against per-customer baselines, with alerting into the case

Leads the AlFursan Data & Insights function, turning member, commercial, and program data into insights that drive growth, engagement, retention, personalization, and product performance. The role owns the AlFursan KPI framework, performance dashboards, and strategic analysis across the member lifecycle, ensuring leadership has a trusted, consistent view of commercial and program performance. The role acts as a trusted advisor to the GM and the wider leadership team, leads and develops the insights team, and owns the function's roadmap and capability agenda.

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Define and own the AlFursan Data & Insights strategy, operating plan and capability roadmap, aligned with the program and Saudia priorities.
* Own the AlFursan KPI architecture, ensuring consistent definitions and a trusted, program-wide view of member, commercial, product, and operational performance.
* Lead analytical work across the full member lifecycle - acquisition, activation, engagement, tier progression, retention, churn, earn, redemption and lifetime value, building segment-level understanding of member needs, behaviors and value.
* Ensure major products, propositions and strategic initiatives have agreed measurement methodologies and benefits-realization plans, and provide analytical challenge during concept development and business-case preparation.
* Oversee test-and-learn and post-launch measurement, ensuring findings improve future design and investment decisions.

**Company Description**
Elinker is a dynamic marketplace that connects skilled individuals with part-time and project-based opportunities, ranging from technical work like coding to hands-on tasks such as home repairs. The platform focuses on efficiently matching client needs with qualified talent, helping both individuals and businesses get work done quickly and reliably. By streamlining the process of finding short-term gigs, Elinker supports flexible work arrangements and empowers professionals to showcase their expertise. The company is growing its technology team to enhance platform features, reliability, and scalability, creating impactful solutions for a diverse user base.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

job_description:
Own the health, security, and continuity of the organisation's core Microsoft platform: Exchange Server 2019 (on-premises) in hybrid with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, and the identity and email-security layers that sit on top of them. The role helps maintain reliable corporate messaging, mailbox availability, and identity services in a multi-site business environment.
  
  
KEY Responsibilities
  
  
Core: Microsoft Exchange (on-premises + hybrid)
  
  

* Install, configure, administer, and upgrade Microsoft Exchange Server 2019 on-premises; apply cumulative updates and security patches on a controlled schedule
* Run and maintain Exchange Hybrid with Microsoft 365: hybrid configuration, free/busy, cross-premises mail flow, and directory synchronisation health
* Execute mailbox migrations (on-prem to/from Exchange Online) with zero-data-loss cutovers and a tested rollback for each wave
* Manage mailbox lifecycle, distribution and shared mailboxes, mail flow, transport rules, send/receive connectors, and certificate lifecycle (issuance, renewal, binding) with no lapsed-certificate outages
* Design, build, and maintain Database Availability Groups (DAG) for Exchange high availability; own failover testing and quorum health
* Diagnose and resolve complex mail-delivery, queue, performance, and availability problems using message tracking, protocol logs, and transport diagnostics

Core: Active Directory & Group Policy
  
  

* Perform advanced Active Directory administration: domain services, sites, trusts, OU design, delegation, user authentication, and permissions
* Design, implement, troubleshoot, and optimise Group Policy (GPO): scope, precedence, security filtering, and drift control
* Administer and maintain DNS and DHCP as authoritative infrastructure services for the estate
* Own AD replication health, security hardening (privileged accounts, tiering), and disaster-recovery readiness for the directory (backup, forest/domain recovery runbook, tested restore)

Core: Email Security
  
  

* Administer the enterprise email-security gateway/solution: anti-spam, anti-phishing, malware protection, content filtering, quarantine management, and policy tuning
* Own the sender-authentication stack (SPF, DKIM, and DMARC) from monitoring through enforcement, and manage mail routing and inbound/outbound threat protection
* Investigate email-borne threats and phishing incidents with Information Security; tune policies to cut false positives

**Job Description Summary**
Support après-vente pour les problèmes client. Cela peut inclure des réparations (retours de pièces et intervention sur le terrain), un support technique ou un service sur site, ou une autre demande de service. Responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution des opérations du département ou axé sur l'exécution d'activités professionnelles au sein d'une discipline technique. Fonctions dotées d'une certaine autonomie, mais guidées par les politiques établies ou l'analyse des résultats finaux.
  
  
Ce poste est autorisé à modifier les procédures et les pratiques en relation avec les tâches dans la mesure où les résultats finaux répondent aux normes d'acceptabilité (qualité, volume, respect des délais, etc.).
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**

* Prend en charge la résolution des problèmes techniques des clients après-vente. Support technique de niveau 1, 2, 3 - Résout les problèmes techniques après vente. À mesure que la profondeur technique requise pour résoudre un problème augmente, le « niveau » de compétences augmente également. Pour certains produits, une personne peut gérer les niveaux 1, 2 et 3, tandis que pour d'autres produits, il peut s'agir d'individus distincts dotés de compétences croissantes.
* Se fonde sur une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique, un esprit d'analyse et une expérience technique pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie.Un poste à ce niveau nécessite un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Inclut la responsabilité directe de la gestion du personnel, y compris la dotation en personnel et le développement de la performance.
* Possède une connaissance approfondie des meilleures pratiques et de la manière dont son propre domaine s'intègre aux autres. Possède une connaissance pratique de la concurrence et des facteurs qui les différencient sur le marché.
* Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis pour traiter des processus de fabrication plus complexes comportant une variété d'aspects techniques et/ou de cycles de production interdépendants. Se fonde sur son expérience technique et un esprit d'analyse. Fait appel à des ressources limitées internes et externes en dehors de ses propres équipes pour l'aider à prendre une décision.
* Agit en tant que ressource pour ses collègues moins expérimentés. Peut piloter de petits projets avec des risques et des besoins en resso

**About the Job**

As a Customer Support Intern at Lean, you will be at the forefront of investigating real client issues from day one as they integrate and use our financial APIs. You’ll join a small, collaborative team where your technical expertise and proactive mindset will directly impact both our clients’ success and our internal operations.

Support at Lean is expanding into TechOps: proactive monitoring that catches problems before clients notice them. Senior engineers on the team lead that work. You'll work alongside them, learn how our monitoring and alerting is built, and if you show the technical depth, take on a scoped piece of extending it.

**About Lean**

Lean is the leading financial infrastructure provider in the Middle East. We power some of the region’s largest companies with APIs that enable payments, account verification, financial data access, and other critical financial infrastructure.

What started as the region’s pioneering Open Banking platform and quickly became the de facto leader in account aggregation and payment initiation in the region is now becoming something bigger: a multi-product infrastructure company powering payments, data, and lending across MENA.

We’ve processed billions of dollars in transactions. We’re trusted by 350+ clients - from Tabby and Tas’heel to Hungerstation - and backed by General Catalyst, Sequoia, and Shorooq. Our $67.5M Series B was just the beginning. We’re expanding into new markets, opening offices, acquiring businesses, and building capabilities that didn’t exist here before.

**Responsibilities**

* Respond to client issues via Plain, Slack, MS Teams, and email, and join client calls alongside senior team members
* Investigate and triage API and product issues using Elasticsearch, SQL, Postman, and our internal admin panels, and resolve the ones within your scope
* Escalate bugs and feature requests to engineering and product with enough context that nobody has to ask a follow-up question
* Turn every recurring issue you solve into documentation: FAQs, runbooks, or client-facing guides
* Shadow incident response and on-call rotations to learn how we handle production issues
* Run basic QA testing during triage to confirm whether an issue is a bug, a configuration problem, or client-side
* Work with senior support engineers on proactive monitoring, and take on a scoped improvement to our alerting or dashboards if you show the depth for it
* Provide feedback that helps tune our AI support agen

job_description:
Have you ever imagined to be part of one of the biggest food companies in the world?
  
  
Nourish life is our commitment. This is not limited to food production – it extends to projects, initiatives and causes we embrace. In order to deliver quality products, we have a team dedicated to innovating every day. We have more than 100,000 employees worldwide. A large team that has a global vision, without leaving aside the local needs.
  
  
Each member of our team is important to make BRF one of the largest food companies in the world. We are guided by values that serve as a compass for our work. Ethics in all actions, transparency in our value chain and innovation are non-negotiable points for us.
  
  
Come and join us to be part of this food giant!
  
  
BRF values and promotes an inclusive and diverse culture. We consider persons with disabilities for all our opportunities.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Proceeding the SAP confirmation according to the corporate norm 03.8.001
* Evaluate the packaging consumption, ensure the correct consumption of this material in SAP
* Evaluate and solve all COGI issues for direct materials materials
* Check in a daily basis the inventory variation between SAP and physical production stock
* Follow the Corporate Norms 03.11.008 and 03.11.034 for Inventory & inventory management
* Maintain very well organized in a specific file, all data about production record and consumption of the materials
* Request and maintain the Anomaly Report for all losses and inventory adjustments
* Adhere to BRF Food safety policy and practices
* Send daily the finished goods production information to factory stakeholders
* Perform the finished goods reconciliation in SAP x actual received from warehouse team
* Correction in SAP transaction MSC2N the date of production x shelf life of finished goods
* Innova (or any other tracebality system implemented in the factory) validation of elaborated used x SAP entry
* SAP reversal and manual entry consumption for coating & elaborated used on the actual record
* Comply with BRF Sustainability Policy guidelines, ensure adherence to BRF Sustainability Plan through activities in its routines that promotes compliance with the indicators and global ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance) commitments of the Company, ensuring the connection between its actions and sustainable development in the BRF chain.

****Academic Background****
Bachelor’s degree in business administration, finance, accounting or relate

* Control release scope, sprint and deployment plans, system environments, transports, dependencies, defects and configuration/development readiness.
* Plan and govern System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression testing, performance testing, security testing and data reconciliation.
* Manage data migration activities, mock loads, reconciliation, cutover planning, interface freezes, rollback arrangements, go-live command centres and stabilization.
* Monitor implementation partner deliverables, estimates, change requests, acceptance criteria, commercial milestones and knowledge transfer.
* Maintain risk, assumption, issue and dependency (RAID) logs, decision registers, action trackers, change controls, quality findings and approval records.

Nova® Water is Saudi Arabia’s most iconic premium bottled water brand, recognized for its uncompromising quality and continuous innovation. As the Kingdom’s leading water brand, Nova® has earned the trust of consumers nationwide and remains a symbol of purity and pride. Rooted in the heart of this land, Nova® continues to set the benchmark for hydration and brand excellence in Saudi Arabia.

**Job Purpose:**

To oversee and execute the branch's accounting operations, ensuring accurate management of accounts receivable, accounts payable, general ledger activities, inventory reconciliations, cash management, and financial reporting. * Provide monthly customer statements and support collection efforts to improve cash flow.
* Monitor compliance with credit control procedures, including signed and stamped invoices.
* Ensure cash customer balances and unapplied receipts are cleared in a timely manner.

* Reconcile vendor statements and resolve discrepancies promptly.
* Monitor supplier aging reports and ensure payments are made within agreed credit terms.
* Coordinate with procurement, operations, and vendors to resolve invoice and payment-related issues.
* Ensure compliance with procurement policies, tax regulations, and internal controls.

job_description:
**About ZeroFox**

ZeroFox is the trusted solution for defending organizations against daily cyber threats that erode revenue, damage reputation, and frustrate security and risk teams. With over a decade of SaaS expertise, ZeroFox unifies Cyber Threat Intelligence, Brand and Domain Protection, Attack Surface Intelligence, Executive Protection, and Physical Security Intelligence in one platform.

Our continuous cycle, Discover, Validate, Disrupt, empowers organizations to identify exposures, prioritize risks, and stop attacks before they cause harm. Thousands of customers worldwide, including leaders in finance, media, retail, healthcare, and government, rely on ZeroFox to deliver timely, actionable intelligence that reduces risk, accelerates response, and defends your world.

You'll own the relationship for a portfolio of customers across industries and company sizes, from Fortune 1000 accounts to fast-moving startups. That means configuring and tuning the ZeroFox platform for each customer's environment, building reporting that shows what the platform actually caught and stopped, and running the training that gets a customer's team using the platform without you in the room. You'll work closely with Product, Customer Operations, and Services, feeding back what you're hearing across your portfolio so it shapes what gets built next instead of staying stuck in one account. When something breaks, or a customer needs something the platform doesn't do out of the box, you're the person who chases it down, not the person who files a ticket and waits.

**The Reality**

You'll thrive here if:

job_description:
**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a highly experienced
**Senior Network Consultant**
to join our networking subject matter expert team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, supporting Cisco.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in carrier-grade network architecture, advanced routing protocols, Segment Routing (SR), and Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6). The role involves designing, deploying, migrating, and optimizing next-generation network infrastructures to deliver high performance, scalability, and reliability.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and architect end-to-end network solutions leveraging Segment Routing (SR) and SRv6.
* Lead network transformation and migration projects from traditional MPLS architectures to SRv6-based environments.
* Deploy, configure, and optimize high-scale routing platforms in multi-vendor environments.
* Perform network performance analysis, capacity planning, and troubleshooting to ensure optimal network performance and reliability.
* Resolve complex routing, latency, path-selection, and connectivity issues.
* Provide technical leadership, knowledge sharing, and mentorship to junior network engineers.
* Collaborate with technical stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective network solutions.

**Required Qualifications:**

* **Experience:**
  10+ years of experience in advanced networking and routing technologies.
* **Routing Protocols:**
  Strong expertise in BGP, OSPF, and IS-IS.
* **Segment Routing:**
  Extensive hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and troubleshooting Segment Routing technologies.
* **SRv6:**
  Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience designing and deploying SRv6 in production environments.
* **Certification:**
  Valid Cisco CCIE or CCDP certification.
* **Troubleshooting:**
  Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex network performance, routing, and connectivity issues.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Knowledge of network automation and programmability tools, including Python, Ansible, and NETCONF/YANG.
* Strong understanding of Traffic Engineering (TE) and Network Slicing.
* Experience with carrier-grade service provider networks and large-scale network transformation projects.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Job Purpose

The HR Data Analyst turns workforce data in Oracle HCM Cloud into accurate reports, dashboards and insights that support HR and business decisions across SRG and its subsidiaries. The role owns HR data quality, builds standard and ad-hoc reporting, and supports workforce planning, recruitment, payroll and Saudization analysis.

Key Responsibilities

**HR Analytics & Reporting**

* Build and maintain monthly, quarterly and annual HR reports: headcount, turnover, attrition, absenteeism, overtime and manpower cost.
* Develop interactive HR dashboards for Group HR leadership and subsidiary management.
* Analyse workforce trends and present clear findings and recommendations to decision-makers.
* Respond to ad-hoc data requests from HR, Finance, PMO and executive management within agreed timelines.

**Oracle HCM Data Management**

* Extract, validate and transform data from Oracle HCM Cloud modules (Core HR, Recruiting/ORC, Payroll, Absence, Talent).
* Build and maintain reports using OTBI and BI Publisher.
* Prepare and validate bulk data loads using HCM Data Loader (HDL) and HCM Spreadsheet Data Loader (HSDL).
* Support Oracle HCM testing, upgrades and enhancements; log and follow up issues with the HRIS or ERP team.

**Recruitment & Workforce Planning Analytics**

* Track recruitment KPIs from ORC: time-to-fill, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, offer acceptance and cost-per-hire.
* Support manpower budgeting, project-based workforce forecasting and vacancy tracking.
* Prepare salary benchmarking, compensation analysis and end-of-service benefit (ESB) liability reports.

**Data Governance & Compliance**

* Own HR data accuracy through regular audits, cleansing and reconciliation between Oracle, payroll and government platforms.
* Produce Saudization (Nitaqat) tracking and reconcile data with Qiwa, GOSI and Mudad.
* Apply PDPL requirements and SRG data access controls when handling employee personal data.
* Document data definitions, report logic and standard operating procedures.

**Stakeholder Support**

* Train HR users on Oracle self-service reporting and data entry standards.
* Work with subsidiary HR teams to align data definitions and reporting across the group.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Systems, Statistics or a related field.
* Preferred: Oracle HCM Cloud certification, CIPD (Level 5 or above), SHRM or a recognised data analytics certificate (Power BI, Google, Microsoft)

job_description:
**About the Role**

On behalf of a leading
**Publicly Listed Joint Stock Company (Tadawul)**
headquartered in Riyadh, we are exclusively seeking a highly analytical and results-driven
**Credit Supervisor & Financial Analyst**
.

In this key supervisory role, you will lead the credit risk management framework, evaluate corporate client solvency, oversee accounts receivable portfolios, and optimize cash flow performance while maintaining strict adherence to corporate governance and regulatory compliance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Credit Risk Assessment:**
  Evaluate B2B clients’ financial health, financial statements, and credit reports (SIMAH/Bayan) to establish appropriate credit limits and terms.
* **Financial Modeling & ECL:**
  Perform financial analysis and compute Expected Credit Loss (ECL) provisions in strict compliance with
  **IFRS 9**
  accounting standards.
* **Portfolio & Aging Management:**
  Monitor accounts receivable aging reports, identify high-risk accounts, and execute effective credit control and recovery strategies.
* **Team Supervision & Cross-Functional Alignment:**
  Oversee credit control workflows, align with Sales & Account Management to ensure smooth collections, and escalate non-performing accounts to Legal when necessary.
* **Executive Reporting & KPIs:**
  Generate periodic executive dashboards tracking Days Sales Outstanding (
  **DSO**
  ), bad debt ratios, collection efficiency, and credit risk exposure.
* **Compliance & Governance:**
  Ensure all credit actions comply with internal risk policies, audit standards, and regulatory requirements for listed entities.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business Administration. Professional credentials (
  **CMA, SOCPA, CFA**
  ) are a major advantage.
* **Experience:**
  4–6+ years of strong experience in credit analysis, financial assessment, or credit control, including at least 2 years in a supervisory role.
* **Technical Expertise:**
* Deep knowledge of
  **IFRS 9**
  and financial analysis techniques.
* Hands-on proficiency with major ERP systems (
  **Oracle / SAP**
  ) and advanced Excel financial modeling.
* Familiarity with Saudi credit bureau tools (
  **SIMAH / Bayan**
  ).
* **Industry Background:**
  Background in publicly traded companies, B2B services, or financial/commercial sectors is highly desirable.
* **Languages:**
  Business fluency in both
  **Arabic and English**
  (spoken and written).

job_description:
**Role Summary**

We are seeking an AI Product Manager to be embedded within the AI Products Management Department. The successful candidate will lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI-driven features, ensuring our AI Products are not just technically sound, but commercially viable and regulatory compliant. The AI Product Manager also bridges the gap between technical Data Scientists and AI Research team, and prospective clients and business stakeholders demands.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Strategy & Roadmap**

Define the product vision for AI initiatives, prioritizing features based on market needs, technical feasibility, and ROI.

* **Model Lifecycle Management**

Collaborate with Data Science and Research teams to guide model development from discovery and training to deployment and tuning.

* **Cross-Functional Leadership**

Serve as the "translator" between Engineering, Design, Legal, and Business stakeholders.

* **Performance Tracking**

Define and monitor success metrics, focusing on both traditional product KPIs and AI-specific metrics like precision, recall, and latency.

* **Privacy and Security Oversight**

Ensures data privacy, bias mitigation, and transparency in all algorithmic outputs.

* **AI Operations**

Specify MLOps/LLMOps requirements, e.g. model registry, CI/CD, prompt/config versioning, observability, monitoring, rollback strategies. Also, define runtime controls including guardrails, policy enforcement, red-teaming, rate limiting, and audit logging.

**Required Experience and Skills**

* **Experience:**
  3–6 years of Product Management experience, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML products.
* **Technical Literacy:**
  Strong understanding of the ML/AI pipeline (data labeling, feature engineering, neural networks, LLMs, RAGs, Agents) without needing to be a developer.
* **Data Proficiency:**
  Ability to interpret complex datasets to drive product decisions.
* **User-Centricity:**
  Proven track record of solving real user problems using predictive or generative technologies.
* **Communication:**
  Exceptional ability to articulate technical constraints to non-technical partners.

**Preferred Experience and Skills**

* Experience with LLM orchestration (LangChain, vector databases) or RAG architectures.
* Background in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

**Competencies**

* Strong written technical communication in Arabic
* System-level thinking and pragmatic technical judgment.
* Product mindset

**About The Company**
CodeNinja is a full-stack Sovereign AI delivery company helping Saudi enterprises and government entities build, own, and compound AI and engineering capability permanently, rather than renting it through vendor contracts. Operating from Riyadh with delivery capability across the Kingdom and the broader MENA region, CodeNinja works across priority sectors including government digitization, energy, financial services, logistics, and healthcare, and is recognized among the 100 fastest-growing technology companies of 2026 by Clutch. Through embedded engineering teams, AI capability centers, and owned application infrastructure, CodeNinja partners with banks and enterprises to modernize systems and operationalize intelligence across mission-critical workflows.
  
  
**About Role**
We're looking for an Appian QA & Automation Engineer to own quality for Appian applications at a leading bank in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. You will build the test strategy and automation that let the team release frequently without regressions in critical banking workflows. This is an onsite role in Riyadh, open to all nationalities, requiring strong test engineering experience on Appian or comparable BPM/low-code platforms.

* Define the test strategy across functional, integration, regression, UAT, performance and security testing

* Run performance and load testing (JMeter, Gatling or Appian performance tooling) for peak banking volumes
* Validate role-based access, maker-checker controls, data masking and audit logs
* Manage test data and environments, including masked production-like data compliant with PDPL
* Lead UAT with business users, track defects through to closure and report quality metrics to delivery leadership

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of total experience, including 6+ years of hands-on Appian development
* Appian Certified Senior Developer (mandatory)
* Notice period of 1 month, or immediate joiners preferred

**Must Haves**

* Expert in SAIL, interface design patterns and Appian Portals/Sites
* Strong Appian Data Fabric skills: record types, sync, relationships, custom record fiel

The company is a growing organization based in Riyadh, focused on building a strong and sustainable financial foundation to support its strategic goals and long-term vision. The Finance Manager leads the day-to-day finance function for Credit Line and the relevant Malaa entities, ensuring accurate accounting, timely financial and regulatory reporting, disciplined liquidity management, effective internal controls, and compliance with IFRS, SAMA, CMA, ZATCA, Saudi Companies Law, and approved Group policies. The role supports the Group CFO through reliable management information, budgeting, audit coordination, finance-team supervision, and continuous process improvement.

**Financial Accounting and Reporting:**

* Own the general ledger and monthly, quarterly, and annual close, including journal review, accruals, provisions, prepayments, depreciation, amortisation, reclassifications, and consolidation submissions.
* Prepare and review management accounts, statutory financial statements, balance-sheet reconciliations, cash-flow reporting, and analysis of material movements and variances.
* Ensure appropriate IFRS accounting for financing activities, revenue and fees, financial instruments and ECL, leases, intangible assets, related parties, provisions, and entity-specific transactions.

**Budgeting and Performance Management:**

* Coordinate annual budgets, rolling forecasts, long-range plans, and monthly budget-versus-actual reporting across business and support functions.
* Challenge assumptions, validate inputs, and provide financial insight on profitability, pricing, investments, operating costs, capital requirements, and resource allocation.
* Develop and monitor financial and operational KPIs, identify adverse trends, and recommend timely corrective actions to management.

**Treasury, Liquidity and Reconciliations:**

* Manage daily cash positioning, liquidity forecasts, funding requirements, payment planning, bank accounts, authorised signatories, and treasury controls.
* Review bank, collection, disbursement, payment-gateway, broker, custodian, portfolio, and intercompany reconciliations, as applicable.
* Ensure reconciling items are investigated, assigned, aged, and cleared promptly, with significant liquidity or settlement risks escalated to the Group CFO.

**Regulatory, Tax and Statutory Compliance:**

* Coordinate accurate and timely SAMA, CMA, and other regulatory returns, ensuring reconciliation to the general ledger, documented data lineage, review evidence, and maker-checker controls.
* Oversee VAT, withholding tax, zakat or corporate tax schedules and filings, including correct treatment of domestic and cross-bord

job_description:
**About Soum**
Soum is a fast-growing B2C marketplace based in Riyadh, connecting buyers and sellers of used electronics and used cars across Saudi Arabia through our website and mobile app. Everything we do is built on trust: buyers need confidence in what they are getting, and sellers need confidence they will be paid fairly and quickly. With the recent launch of our subscription model for electronics and cars, Soum is building the go-to recommerce platform in the Kingdom.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Consumer Product Manager owns the experience our customers touch every day: how buyers discover, evaluate, pay for and receive a used phone or car, and how sellers list, price and get paid for what they sell. You will be the voice of the Soum customer inside the product team, turning deep consumer insight into features that grow conversion, repeat purchase and trust in the platform.
  
  
You will work across the app and web, partnering with design, engineering, operations and commercial teams to ship quickly and learn from what we ship.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the roadmap for a core consumer area (such as the buyer journey, the seller journey or subscriptions), prioritising ruthlessly by impact on conversion, retention, GMV and customer trust.
* Build a deep, continuous understanding of Soum's customers through user interviews, usability testing, app reviews, customer support tickets and behavioural data.
* Optimise the end-to-end marketplace funnel: listing creation, search and discovery, product pages, checkout and payments (Mada, Apple Pay, BNPL), delivery tracking, returns and post-purchase experience.
* Design and improve trust features that make buying used feel safe, including device condition grading, car inspection reports, verified sellers, buyer protection, ratings and transparent pricing.
* Shape the subscription products for electronics and cars: the value proposition, packaging, onboarding, engagement and retention, working closely with Commercial and Finance on unit economics.
* Translate problems into clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and run agile delivery with design and engineering, from discovery through release and iteration.
* Champion an Arabic-first, bilingual experience with high-quality RTL design and localisation for Saudi customers.
* Run a disciplined experimentation practice: form hypotheses, design A/B tests, define success metrics and make fast, evidence-based decisions on what to scale or kill.

**About Noon**
Noon is a Saudi EdTech company. Noon Track runs inside schools: a hybrid programme that prepares students for Qudrat (قدرات) and Tahsili (تحصيلي), the national university-admission exams. Our students are 15 to 17 years old. Noon is becoming an AI-native company, department by department, and the number of schools we serve is growing. We believe every student deserves world-class teachers. And to make it happen, we’re reimagining everything about education: from cutting-edge tech to peer learning and physical spaces that spark curiosity.
  
  

* Hear about our vision directly from our CEO here.
* Learn more about us [here]

**The role**
You will be the one designer who owns the student experience. Primarily that means the student app: where students study, work with an AI tutor, answer questions, and take part in activities, including games and head-to-head duels on a topic. You will also shape parts of the live classroom experience.
  
  
This is a Senior/Principal-level individual contributor Product Designer role. There is no design team underneath you and no manager drawing your roadmap. You take a problem from the first student conversation to the shipped screen, and you decide what to look at next.
  
  
**Why this role**

* One owner of the whole student experience, with a direct line to leadership.
* Speed: with AI in the workflow, ideas go from research to release in days, not quarters.
* An experimentation practice being built from the ground up, with you shaping it.
* A company expanding into more schools, with a long-term ambition to match.

**What You Will Do**

* Spend real time with students in Saudi schools. Interviews, focus groups, classroom observation. Turn what you hear into design decisions, and go back to check them.
* Design for Saudi Arabia, not for the generic "best practice" app. Patterns that work in London or San Francisco often fail here. You know why, and you can show it in your work.
* Own the student app end to end. Flows, information architecture, prototypes, final UI, and the handover to engineering.
* Design activities students want to come back to, games and duels included, with learning as the gate: an activity that is more fun but teaches less is a regression.
* Run experiments. State a hypothesis, build the variants, agree the metric, and read the result honestly. You will help build the experimentation practice, not just use it.
* Work AI-native. Use AI tools for generation, prototyping and productio

job_description:
About Lucid

  

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. 

  

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

  
  
Position Overview

Functional leader accountable for automation, controls, robotics, vision, SCADA/historian, OT cybersecurity and MES-OT integration across AMP-2 Drive Unit and HV Battery shops. From commissioning through stable high-volume operation to deliver safe, capable and sustainable Powertrain operations while accelerating local technical capability and launch readiness.

  
Key ResponsibilitiesStrategy, architecture & governance

• Define PLC/HMI/SCADA/Ignition, safety-control, network, naming, code-library, backup and version-control standards.

  

• Govern Siemens TIA Portal, Rockwell Studio 5000 and Beckhoff TwinCAT populations; establish lifecycle and obsolescence roadmaps.

  

• Own OT cybersecurity governance including segmentation, secure remote access, privilege, backup/recovery and patch coordination.

  
Robotics, vision & digital manufacturing

• Own Robotics like FANUC or ABB standards, safety validation, uptime, recovery, program governance and critical spares.

  

• Govern Cognex/Keyence/other machine-vision applications, inspection integrity, recipe control and traceability.

  

• Sponsor historian, IIoT, digital SPC, condition monitoring and analytics use cases with Data, IT/OT and MES teams.

  
Launch & operational excellence

• Own automation FAT/SAT, controls lists, production-release criteria, run-at-rate support and safe launch escalation.

  

• E

job_description:
We are seeking a highly experienced **Principal Cloud Operations Engineer**to serve as the technical authority for our **Managed Services** practice. This individual will lead cloud operations architecture, automation strategy, service transitions, operational governance, and engineering excellence across enterprise customer environments.

  
  
  

The successful candidate will combine deep hands-on expertise with cloud-native technologies and operational leadership, helping shape and scale a high-performing cloud operations practice.

  
  
 Key Responsibilities

  
* Serve as the technical authority for Managed Services cloud operations.
* Define cloud operations standards, reference architectures and operational governance.
* Lead customer onboarding, service transitions and operational readiness assessments.
* Drive Infrastructure-as-Code, automation and platform engineering initiatives.
* Establish and maintain runbooks, operational procedures and escalation frameworks.
* Act as the highest technical escalation point for major incidents and problem management.
* Mentor engineers and help build a world-class cloud operations capability.
* Contribute to solution design, service architecture and managed services growth initiatives.

Required Experience

  
* 12+ years in cloud infrastructure and operations.
* 3-5+ years in a Cloud Architect, Principal Engineer, Practice Lead, or Technical Leadership role.
* Experience building and scaling cloud operations teams and processes.
* Deep expertise in at least one hyperscaler (GCP preferred).
* Experience operating mission-critical enterprise cloud environments.
* Strong background in cloud automation and Infrastructure-as-Code.

Technical Requirements

  
* Kubernetes (expert level)
* Terraform (expert level)
* Ansible (expert level)
* CI/CD platforms
* Python and Bash scripting
* Cloud networking, identity and security
* SRE principles, observability and incident management

Certifications

**Required**

  
  
  

  
* Professional-level GCP cloud certification
* Candidates without GCP certification but able to complete certification upon joining may be considered

  

**Preferred**

  
  
  

  
* Professional-level cloud certification in (AWS, Azure or OCI)
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
* Additional cloud certifications

Preferred Background

  
* Managed Services
* Cloud Operations
* Site Reliability Engineering
* Enterprise Platform Engineering
* Multi-cloud environments

job_description:
Network Engineer, Nahil Computers (Riyadh, on-site, full-time)

Nahil Computers, a leading IT system integrator in Saudi Arabia, is hiring a Network Engineer based in Saudi Arabia.

How to apply: complete our application form at https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/R2keuuH4KB. Applications without the completed form will not be considered.

Application link: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/R2keuuH4KB

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 1-2 years of hands-on experience installing, configuring, and supporting Cisco networking equipment.
* Cisco CCNA certification (recommended).
* Good understanding of TCP/IP, IPv4 addressing, subnetting, and network troubleshooting.
* Practical knowledge of VLANs, trunking, STP, EtherChannel, and inter-VLAN routing.
* Familiarity with static routing, OSPF, ACLs, NAT, and DHCP.
* Basic knowledge of network security, VPN concepts, and secure device management.
* Basic knowledge of wireless networking, access points, wireless controllers, and Wi-Fi troubleshooting.
* Ability to use Cisco IOS/IOS XE CLI for configuration and troubleshooting.
* Ability to perform configuration backups and restores, and to assist with firmware upgrades.
* Basic understanding of copper and fiber cabling, SFP modules, and rack installation.
* Ability to prepare network diagrams, configuration records, and technical documentation.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to escalate complex issues appropriately.
* Good communication skills in English and the ability to work effectively with customers and internal teams.

Candidates must currently live in Saudi Arabia.

Pay: ﷼3,000.00 - ﷼7,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

job_description:
**High-level Job Purpose Statement**
The IT Support Specialist provides Level 1 and Level 2 support for employees using company devices, Microsoft 365 services, approved software, printers, connectivity, and workplace technology. The position owns each assigned ticket from acknowledgement through resolution or correct escalation, maintains accurate records in Freshservice, supports onboarding and offboarding, and helps keep Head Office and branch users productive
  
  
The role does not independently own every network, server, cloud, security, or business application platform. It performs first-line diagnosis, collects evidence, applies approved fixes, communicates with the requester, and routes specialist work to the correct resolver group while retaining follow-up responsibility.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
**Service Desk and User Support**

* Provide timely Level 1 and Level 2 technical support through Freshservice, telephone, remote-access tools, email, and desk-side assistance
* Acknowledge, classify, prioritize, investigate, update, and resolve assigned incidents and service requests within the applicable service targets
* Maintain ownership of the requester experience even when a ticket is assigned to a specialist team or external vendor
* Troubleshoot Windows devices and provide working-level support for macOS, browsers, Microsoft Office applications, printers, scanners, monitors, docking stations, and standard peripherals
* Confirm the solution with the requester and record meaningful resolution notes before closure

**Microsoft 365 Accounts and Access**

* Support Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, Office activation, shared mailboxes, distribution lists, and common Microsoft 365 user issues

**Endpoint and Employee Lifecycle Support**

* Prepare, configure, test, and deploy laptops, desktops, all-in-one devices, monitors, phones, and approved accessories
* Complete onboarding activities, including hardware allocation, Microsoft 365 setup, approved software such as Adobe and Chrome, policy synchronization, quality checks, and handover or shipment to the employee's branch
* Process approved transfer, role-change, and offboarding tasks, including access changes, asset return, mailbox or data ownership handover, and completion evidence
* Maintain accurate asset assignment, stock, warranty, configuration, and return records in the approved inventory or ITSM system
* Apply approved endpoint standards, updates, security controls, and software

Site Project Engineer
  
  
**Job Scope**
The Site Project Engineer is responsible for managing, engineering construction projects and ensuring the proper implementation of project deliverables. S/He supervises and provides technical advice to the staff on site to complete the project on time and within budget.

* Formulate project parameters and ensure technical feasibility and desired quality in coordination with the direct manager
* Coordinate and allocate internal resources to deliver customer outcomes
* Prepare, schedule, coordinate and monitor assigned projects on site
* Cooperate regularly with the direct manager and report updates on budgets, schedules, plans and performance of site projects
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to create more efficient project methods and maintain project’s profitability
* Create a framework to measure the project’s metrics and data collection while recommending improvements
* Establish field test methods, conduct regular quality checks and ensure the project’s compliance with applicable practices, policies, performance standards and specifications
* Conduct regular safety inspections and ensure abidance by occupational health and safety measures
* Prepare site reports and maintain comprehensive project documentation
* Manage changes to the project scope, schedule and cost in coordination with the direct manager

**Position Requirements**
**Education**
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or any other related field
  
  
**Experience**
At least 3 years of relevant experience

نبحث عن قائد تنفيذي يمتلك خبرة واسعة في إدارة وتشغيل المشاريع، والقدرة على قيادة الأداء التشغيلي والتجاري والمالي، وإدارة العلاقة مع العملاء، وتحقيق مستهدفات النمو والجودة والربحية.

نستهدف كفاءات قيادية تجمع بين الحضور التنفيذي، والتفكير التجاري، والفهم المالي، والقدرة على قيادة فرق متعددة التخصصات ومتابعة التنفيذ ميدانيًا.

**المسؤوليات الرئيسية :**

* قيادة العمليات التشغيلية والإشراف على مشاريع التطوير والتحسين المستمر.
* تمثيل الجهة أمام العميل وإدارة الاجتماعات والتوقعات والالتزامات التعاقدية.
* تطوير تجربة الزائر ورفع جودة الخدمات ومستويات الرضا.
* تنمية الإيرادات والمبيعات وتطوير الشراكات والقنوات التجارية.
* إدارة الميزانيات ومتابعة الإيرادات والمصروفات والربحية (P&L) والفوترة والتحصيل.
* قيادة فرق العمل ومتابعة مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية.
* إدارة المخاطر والتحديات التشغيلية والتغييرات في نطاق العمل.
* إعداد التقارير التنفيذية واتخاذ القرارات اللازمة لضمان تحقيق الأهداف.

**المتطلبات والمؤهلات :**

* خبرة إجمالية من 12 إلى 15 سنة، منها 5 سنوات على الأقل في مناصب قيادية.
* خبرة مباشرة في إدارة الأداء المالي والميزانيات والأرباح والخسائر (P&L).
* سجل إنجازات مثبت في إدارة العمليات وتنمية الإيرادات وتحسين الأداء التجاري.
* يفضل وجود خبرة في الوجهات السياحية والترفيهية أو الضيافة أو المعالم أو المنشآت الخدمية ذات الإقبال الجماهيري.
* درجة البكالوريوس في إدارة الأعمال أو الضيافة أو السياحة أو الهندسة الصناعية أو تخصص ذي صلة، ويفضل ماجستير إدارة الأعمال (MBA).
* إجادة اللغتين العربية والإنجليزية.
* الاستعداد للعمل والتواجد الميداني في مكة المكرمة.

* Manage changes to the project scope, schedule and cost in coordination with the direct manager

At least 3 years of relevant experience

• Ability to manage repetitive tasks while maintaining focus and accuracy.

• Clear written communication and willingness to receive and apply feedback.

DAZZ is seeking a detail-oriented Accountant to support our growing finance and operations teams. This role will manage day-to-day accounting activities, maintain accurate financial records, and help ensure timely reconciliations and compliance with Saudi tax requirements.

The role will work across accounts payable, accounts receivable, VAT, and cash-on-delivery (COD) transactions. Logistics experience is preferred, especially in environments with frequent transactions and delivery-related settlements.

* Record and maintain accurate financial transactions and supporting documentation in Qoyod.

* Practical knowledge of bookkeeping, accounts payable, and accounts receivable.
* Familiarity with Saudi VAT and ZATCA requirements.
* Hands-on experience with Qoyod.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including working with large data sets, formulas, lookups, and pivot tables.
* Proficiency in both Arabic and English.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.
* Ability to manage recurring deadlines and resolve discrepancies independently.
* Logistics industry experience preferred.

Company Description  

John Crane, a business of Smiths Group, is a global leader in mission-critical flow control solutions for energy and process industries that enable efficient and sustainable operations. Our products include mechanical seals and systems, couplings, filtration systems, and predictive digital monitoring technologies.

  

We have a global network of more than 200 sites in over 50 countries and employ more than 6,000 people worldwide. We partner with our customers to help them keep their operations safe, reduce downtime, improve efficiency, and meet the latest environmental standards.

  

John Crane is part of Smiths Group. For over 170 years, Smiths has been pioneering progress by engineering for a better future. We serve millions of people every year, helping to create a safer, more efficient, productive, and better-connected world across four global markets: energy, security & defence, space & aerospace, and general industrial. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, Smiths employs approximately 16,000 colleagues in over 50 countries.

  
  
Job Description  

**Job Purpose:**

  

* Lead and coordinate dedicated project teams in the delivery of projects, including sales, engineering, procurement, quality, Projects/EPC KAMs, Customers/OEMs, and others.
* Perform project risk evaluation throughout the entire project lifetime; identify issues jeopardizing a successful project completion at an early stage and initiate corrective actions.
* Coordinate the resolution of any technical or commercial conflicts which may arise at any stage.
* Act as John Crane's single point of contact to support the customer for post-order activity through to project delivery. Coordinate any post-delivery issue resolution.
* Maintain communication channels with the client.

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Fulfilment of customer contracts (deadlines, costs, objectives) and monitor project budgets closely.
* Creating and maintaining detailed execution schedules for each of the major projects that are your portfolio.
* Agreeing communication channels with the customer in relation to the different Project aspects.
* Managing timely and effective communication with the regional Stakeholders to ensure effective coordination.
* Regularly communicate with the involved parties and keep constant and updated communication with their various senior-level project management.
* Attending clarification/kick-off meetings and preparing and distributing relevant activity reports.
*

Function: Pricing & Monetization · 1 opening · Riyadh

**About SHIFTER**

SHIFTER is a Saudi B2B delivery orchestration platform. We connect merchants with licensed delivery operators through one platform: a direct technical integration, a prepaid account, transparent pricing, and a service level that is agreed upfront and reported every month. We own no fleet and employ no drivers. We start in Riyadh.

**The role**

You will own how SHIFTER makes money: the products and packages we sell to merchants and delivery operators, the rate card behind them, and the margin on every order. You report to the CEO and work daily with sales, operations and finance.

**What you will do**

* Own the merchant and operator rate cards, including distance bands, extra-kilometre fees and operator payouts, and model the margin impact of every change before it is proposed.
* Design and maintain SHIFTER's packages per merchant segment (restaurants, health and beauty, retail and e-commerce, B2B) with clear inclusions and limits.
* Approve or reject every non-standard discount or commercial offer from sales against a written pricing policy; no off-policy deal is signed without your review.
* Build and run the unit-economics model: revenue, operator cost, payment fees and contribution margin per order, per zone and per account.
* Track price realisation, margin, win/loss and churn by package every month and recommend changes with numbers.
* Benchmark competitor delivery pricing in Riyadh every quarter and brief management on threats and opportunities.
