job_description:
Every day, patients, caregivers and doctors talk online about the conditions our clients treat. We're looking for someone who can listen to those conversations, figure out what actually matters, and turn it into a story our account, content and strategy teams can act on.
  
  
You already know pharma and healthcare marketing. You get why a post about a rare disease reads differently than one about allergies, and how MLR shapes what a brand can say. You love social, and data is how you find the insight, not the end goal.
  
  
You'll join a small, talented analytics team and report to our
**Associate Director of Social Analytics.**
**Responsibilities:**

* Listen to online conversations among patients, caregivers and HCPs, and spot the trends, tensions and moments that matter for our healthcare and life sciences brands
* Turn what you find into clear recommendations on messaging, targeting and content, not just a summary of what happened
* Tell the story behind the numbers in a way account and creative teams can use, and present it to clients with confidence
* Track how social and organic content performs across Meta, Instagram, LinkedIn, X and beyond, and explain what's working and why
* Report on website and organic performance alongside social, so the full picture is in one place
* Build clean, easy-to-read reports and dashboards for internal teams and clients
* Work side by side with account, content and strategy teams from campaign planning through results
* Help shape where our analytics practice goes next, from testing new tools to potentially launching surveys and research

**Requirements:**

* 2 to 4 years in social media, social insights or marketing analytics, with real experience on pharma or healthcare brands (agency-side is a big plus)
* Hands-on experience with at least one social listening platform, and an example of an insight you found that changed what a team did
* A working understanding of how MLR, compliance and audience sensitivity shape healthcare marketing
* Strong storytelling: you can explain what the data means to people who don't live in spreadsheets
* Comfort with Excel or Google Sheets and a visualization tool like Tableau, Power BI or Looker Studio
* A sharp eye for detail and pride in getting the numbers right

**You might be:**
an agency social analyst, a social strategist or community manager who loves the data side, a health PR or medcomms analyst, or a social insights specialist at a healthcare brand.

Tamara is a leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region with a mission to help people own their dreams built on being simple, trusted, and everywhere our customers need us. * Self-motivated, with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.
  
  
Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. * Strengthen reporting, planning processes, data quality and automation.

*Hello, we're L'Oréal. We're not just building brands, we're shaping how the world experiences beauty (and it takes a lot of cool jobs to do it).*
*Intrigued? Keep reading, this might be the opportunity you've been searching for.*
**A Day in the Life**
You ensure the right products reach shelves at the right time, balancing high service rates with optimal inventory levels. Reporting to the Supply Planning Manager, you act as the vital link between commercial demand and physical operations across our global network of 36 plants and 158 fulfillment centres.
  
  

* Build and fine-tune entity supply plans based on validated forecasts, establishing precise inventory parameters for cost, volume, and service targets.
* Anticipate logistical bottlenecks and mitigate shortage risks by partnering closely with manufacturing sites and logistics leads on capacity constraints.
* Monitor weekly KPIs—including out-of-stock rates, service levels, and stock days—taking rapid, proactive action to resolve supply imbalances.
* Manage inventory health by actively reducing obsolete and slow-moving stock, upholding our 'L'Oréal for the Future' waste-reduction targets.
* Drive process improvements and modern planning tools within the team, embedding best practices across the local supply chain community.

**We Are Looking For**
You bring sharp analytical precision, a pragmatic approach to operational challenges, and a clear focus on service excellence. You bring:
  
  

* Supply Chain Planning: Proven track record in building balanced replenishment and supply plans in fast-moving consumer goods or complex retail environments.

**COGNNA** is redefining modern cybersecurity with Nexus, our Agentic AI SOC platform, and our Smart MDR services. We help organizations across the region and around the world cut alert noise, respond to incidents faster and stay compliant with frameworks such as SAMA, NCA, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS.

Behind it all: AI-driven triage, deep automation and our elite 24/7 Guardians Team, delivering unified visibility and rapid threat containment across endpoint, cloud and network.

As our **DevOps Engineer Intern**, you will learn by doing. You'll work alongside senior engineers to provision multi-cloud infrastructure, keep Kubernetes environments healthy, configure GitOps pipelines and support cloud security operations.

* Keep IAM clean: review access requests, update role definitions and manage service-account hygiene under guidance.
* Watch costs: track utilization, spot unused or over-provisioned resources, filter logs and set up budget alerts.
* Learn the network: navigate VPCs, firewall rules and private connectivity; support routine security patching and Vanta compliance tasks.

2. Kubernetes & containers (GKE)

* Monitor cluster health: track status, resource usage and reliability metrics across development and staging clusters.
* Troubleshoot: help investigate pod scheduling issues, container crashes and resource bottlenecks.
* Partner with developers: learn and share containerization best practices, from Dockerfiles to multi-stage builds.
* Shadow upgrades: join senior engineers during Kubernetes upgrades and maintenance windows.

3. CI/CD (ArgoCD & GitHub Actions)

* Onboard services to GitOps: draft ArgoCD Application manifests, sync policies and environment configurations.
* Catch drift: monitor ArgoCD for out-of-sync applications and flag them to the team.
* Improve pipelines: integrate security scanners, linters and tests into GitHub Actions workflows.

4. Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)

* Shadow migrations: learn how complex manual infrastructure is moved into code.
* Write modules: build and maintain modular Terraform that brings unmanaged resources under version control.

The Senior Engineer I is responsible for the activities related to an assigned organizational element, program, project, or task. Will normally plan, conduct, and supervise engineering design reviews and analysis assignments involving a major project or several smaller or less complex projects. These projects, by nature of their complexity and difficulty, require the fully competent application of conventional knowledge in a particular engineering or scientific field. Project work and assignments may be broad, requiring ingenuity and cross-functional coordination.

**What You Will Do:**

* Provides day-to-day leadership of Engineering staff assigned. Assigns projects to Engineers and monitors the progress of all assigned projects. Ensures the delivery of high-quality service and maintenance of good customer relations.
* Devises new approaches to problems encountered and makes recommendations for changes in methods, procedures, or design where necessary.
* Monitors the technical quality, content, consistency, continuity, and timeliness of action of all assigned projects.
* Applies intensive and diversified knowledge of engineering principles and practices in broad areas of technical responsibility. Performs engineering reviews and analyses when necessary. Reviews other engineers' work and provides appropriate guidance and training when necessary.
* Participates in the development and changes of Rules. Advises assigned staff in matters related to the application of Rules and Regulations.
* Prepares written responses to clients in accordance with established procedures.
* Maintains liaison with other engineering specialists internally and externally.
* Monitors the performance, development potential, and training needs of engineers assigned. Keeps management informed of manpower needs.
* Develops or assists in the development of qualification statements, proposals, bids, and other presentation materials.

**What You Will Need:**

Education and Experience

* B.S. degree in Civil, Structural Engineering, Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or other related disciplines; an M.S. is preferred
* The following are new hire requirements for university graduates and experienced engineers from the industry:
* Graduate from University and a minimum of five (5) years of related experience.

For those with Hull backgrounds

* B.S. degree in Civil, Structural Engineering, Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or other related disciplines; an M.S. is preferred

We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarters in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners.

**The Role in a Nutshell**

Foodics Financial Services builds the money products that help restaurants and merchants across the region run their businesses: payments, capital, and cashflow tools. We operate in a regulated environment (SAMA in Saudi Arabia, with expansion into the UAE), which means we care deeply about reliability, security, and correctness. We also move fast and ship products merchants actually feel.

We're looking for a Lead Engineer who thinks like a product owner, builds like a full-stack engineer, and works AI-first by default.

* Own problems end to end. Take ambiguous business problems from discovery through design, build, launch, and iteration. Work across backend services, APIs, data, and frontend as needed.
* Spot the gaps. Find what's missing or broken on both sides: a flow that confuses merchants, a reconciliation process that doesn't scale, a service that will fail under the next 10x of volume. Then drive the fix, even when nobody asked.
* Shape product direction. Partner with Product, Design, Risk, and Compliance to define what we build and why. Challenge requirements, propose alternatives, and bring data to the conversation.
* Set the technical bar. Lead architecture decisions for systems that handle real money: idempotency, consistency, auditability, security, and observability built in from day one.
* Lead the AI-first shift. Use AI tools and agents to multiply your own output, and help the team adopt them well. Identify where AI can improve our products and our engineering workflow, and build it.
* Multiply the team. Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, raise the quality of design reviews and code reviews, and make the people around you better.
* Pick the right tool. Evaluate and adopt languages

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
**Work Location: KSA**
**Experience Required:**
Hands-on experience with Spark development, Informatica integration solutions, and enterprise data platforms.
  
Years of experience: 5 to 10

Role Overview

We are looking for a
**Data Engineer**
to build, configure, and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and consumption workloads on a modern on-premises lakehouse platform. * Design and develop scalable data ingestion and transformation pipelines
* Build, optimize, and maintain Spark-based ETL/ELT workloads
* Develop and manage data models and datasets using Apache Iceberg tables
* Implement and support data integration workflows using Informatica
* Enable analytics and data consumption through Denodo, Starburst, and/or Dremio
* Develop secure, governed, and scalable data pipelines aligned with enterprise standards
* Support batch and near real-time data processing requirements
* Implement data quality, metadata management, and validation controls
* Collaborate with Platform Engineers on deployment, integration, and operationalization activities
* Support migration, testing, and production rollout initiatives
* Troubleshoot and optimize data pipeline performance, reliability, and scalability

Must-Have Skills

* Apache Spark (PySpark and/or Scala Spark)
* Apache Iceberg
* Informatica Data Integration
* MinIO Object Storage
* Denodo
* SQL and Data Modeling
* Data Warehousing Concepts
* ETL/ELT Development
* Git Version Control

Good-to-Have Skills

* Starburst and/or Dremio
* Data Governance and Metadata Management
* Data Quality Frameworks
* CI/CD for Data Pipelines
* Python
* Kafka or Streaming Technologies
* Lakehouse Architecture Patterns
* Experience with enterprise data lake and lakehouse implementations
* Performance tuning and optimization of large-scale data workloads

========================================

**Job Title:** Power BI Developer  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Location:** KSA  
**Preferred Experience:** Hands-on experience developing and supporting Power BI solutions in large-scale enterprise environments, including Power BI Report Server (PBIRS). **3 to 5 years**

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are seeking a skilled **Power BI Developer** with strong expertise in building, optimizing, and maintaining enterprise dashboards and reports. The ideal candidate will be capable of independently managing end-to-end report development and support activities, preferably within an **on-premises Power BI Report Server (PBIRS)** environment.

The role requires strong proficiency in Power BI development, DAX, data modeling, report optimization, and enterprise reporting best practices to deliver scalable and business-driven analytics solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and reports using advanced visualizations, bookmarks, drill-throughs, tooltips, conditional formatting, and dynamic navigation.

* Utilize Power Query (M) for data extraction, transformation, cleansing, and integration.
* Develop and manage data models including star schemas, fact and dimension tables, relationships, KPIs, and business logic.
* Write and optimize SQL queries for data extraction, validation, and reporting purposes.
* Connect and integrate Power BI reports with enterprise databases, data warehouses, and other supported data sources.
* Create and maintain JSON theme files, reusable report templates, and visualization standards.
* Implement Row-Level Security (RLS) and manage report access, permissions, and secure data connectivity.
* Optimize report performance using DAX Studio, Performance Analyzer, and best practices for semantic modeling.
* Publish, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot reports within Power BI Report Server (PBIRS).
* Perform data reconciliation, functional testing, regression testing, and production support activities.
* Troubleshoot report issues and ensure data accuracy, reliability, and performance.
* Support report migration, source connection updates, and modernization initiatives while preserving existing functionality.
* Maintain technical docume

**THE ROLE**

The Ontology, Knowledge Graph & Semantic Layer Lead defines, designs and leads the first implementation of an enterprise ontology, knowledge graph and semantic layer programme. This is a foundational, strategic role for someone who pairs deep hands on semantic technology expertise with enterprise architecture experience, and who has already delivered ontology and knowledge graph programmes at scale. You’ll set the target state, build the roadmap and governance, and get the first capabilities live.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Define the target state architecture and strategy for the enterprise ontology, knowledge graph and semantic layer
* Design enterprise semantic models, taxonomies and ontologies aligned with business and data domains
* Build the roadmap, governance framework, standards and operating model
* Lead the initial implementation phases and guide the build of foundational ontology and knowledge graph capabilities
* Identify and prioritise business use cases and quick wins
* Align the programme with Data Governance, Metadata Management, MDM, Data Products, Data Catalog and AI initiatives
* Advise on tooling, platform selection and architecture decisions
* Build internal capability through knowledge transfer and mentoring

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* 10+ years in Data Architecture, Semantic Technologies, Knowledge Engineering and Knowledge Management
* Proven experience leading enterprise scale ontology initiatives, knowledge graph implementations and semantic architecture programmes
* Strong grounding in ontology engineering, taxonomy development, knowledge representation, semantic modelling and metadata management
* Experience defining target state enterprise semantic architectures
* Solid understanding of Data Governance, Metadata Management, Enterprise Architecture and Business Architecture
* Experience using ontologies and knowledge graphs to power AI, GenAI, RAG, enterprise search and knowledge management
* Deep experience with several of: RDF, OWL, RDFS, SKOS, SPARQL, SHACL, property graphs, LPG and RDF graph models, semantic reasoning and inferencing
* Hands on experience with knowledge graph platforms such as Stardog, GraphDB, TopBraid, PoolParty, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Microsoft Fabric / Purview semantic capabilities or the Databrick

Accenture is a leading global professional services company helping the world's leading enterprises reinvent — building their digital core, unleashing the power of AI, and creating value at speed and scale. We are recruiting an A&D System Manager for a dedicated full-time team delivering accreditation at a major international multi-sport event. The role sits within our client’s Accreditation function. It is based on site in Riyadh, KSA, and runs from ASAP until the end of December 2026, covering system readiness, event time and close-out.

The event will bring together thousands of athletes and team officials from across the region, competing across multiple sports and venues.

You will:

* Run the A&D system provided by the Organising Committee as part of the Event Management System (EMS)
* Make sure the registration and accreditation data of every stakeholder group is accurate and secure
* Get the system tested, validated and fully ready before the event begins

* Provide support and assistance to other departments

In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

**Job Description:**

We are currently recruiting for a **HSE Lead** for our project in Tabuk, You will lead health, safety and environmental (HSE) assurance for the Water Pipeline project, ensuring Contractors deliver the works safely and in compliance with contractual HSE requirements, project HSE standards and Saudi regulations.

  
  

Oversee Contractor HSE performance across pipeline corridors, pump stations and associated works, drive a strong safety culture, and support zero harm through effective risk management, assurance, incident management and continuous improvement.

  
  

**What You'll Be Doing**

  
  

* Review and approve Contractor HSE deliverables, including HSE Plans, Environmental Management Plans, risk assessments, method statements, emergency response plans and traffic management plans.

* Oversee control of high-risk pipeline activities, including deep excavations, trenching, lifting operations, pipe handling, confined space entry, hot work, hydrotesting, working near live utilities and energisation.

* Monitor implementation of the permit-to-work system, safe systems of work and critical risk controls across pipeline corridors, pump stations and reservoir sites.

* Plan and conduct HSE inspections, audits and site walks, tracking findings and corrective actions through to close-out.

* Lead or support incident reporting and investigation, root cause analysis and the sharing of lessons learned.

* Oversee road and driving safety across long linear pipeline corridors, including journey management, fatigue management, defensive driving and logistics traffic controls.

* Ensure environmental controls are implemented, including waste management, dust, noise, spill prevention, water discharge from hydrotesting, and protection of sensitive habitats.

* Oversee worker welfare, heat stress management and emergency response arrangements for remote linear sites, including drills and medical evacuation.

* Prepare HSE performance reports and KPIs (leading and lagging), and present HSE performance and risks to project leadership.

* Promot

* Ensure operational data remains secure, traceable, and aligned with enterprise risk management standards.

job_description:
**About Accenture**
Accenture is a leading global professional services company helping the world's leading enterprises reinvent — building their digital core, unleashing the power of AI, and creating value at speed and scale. We bring together deep industry expertise, cutting-edge technology, and bold thinking to deliver outcomes that matter.
  
  
You'll be on the front line of 24x7 SOC operations protecting enterprise clients against active threats. This isn't a passive monitoring role — you'll be triaging, investigating, and responding to real incidents, working within a high-performing global delivery team where speed, accuracy, and judgment all matter.
  
  
  
- Monitor and analyze security alerts from SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and other security tools to identify potential threats across client environments
- Perform timely triage, validation, and investigation of alerts in line with SLA requirements and prioritization frameworks (P1–P4)
- Execute containment, response, and remediation actions using established SOC runbooks
- Manage incidents through the full case lifecycle — accurate documentation, status updates, and closure in the case management system
- Monitor SOC communication channels and ensure timely response to inquiries, escalations, and stakeholder coordination
- Escalate high-severity and complex incidents in line with SLAs, including immediate notification for potential P1/P2 cases
- Conduct effective shift handovers, ensuring active and critical cases are transferred with full context
- Identify and report operational gaps, anomalies, or delays within the same shift to relevant leads
- Contribute to continuous improvement by surfacing gaps in detection, logging, automation, and case handling processes
**What You'll Need**- Strong understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals — threat types, attack vectors, the CIA triad, and incident response principles
- Working knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux/Unix) and networking concepts (TCP/IP, OSI model, DNS, HTTP/S)
- Hands-on experience or familiarity with SIEM/SOAR platforms, endpoint protection, firewalls, and security monitoring tools
- Ability to analyze logs, network traffic, and endpoint telemetry to identify malicious activity
- Disciplined and process-oriented — able to work effectively in a shift-based, SLA-driven environment
- Clear communicator with strong documentation habits and the ability to coordinate across internal and external stakeholders
- Bachelor's degree in Cybers

job_description:
Who We Are
  
  
At BCG Platinion, we close the gap between strategy and technology. We design and build AI tech strategies, AI solutions, and next-generation platform architectures that turn ambition into execution, turning buzzwords into a true business engine and real competitive advantage.
  
  
Working at the intersection of boardroom strategy and hands-on tech delivery, we help leading organizations tackle their toughest challenges, with access to C-suite leaders and the unmatched resources of BCG.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* You have a degree in computer science, (business) informatics, or a related discipline
* You have 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in IT Consulting or software development
* You know that modern technologies such as machine learning, cyber resilience, DevOps, agile methods, AI, and robotics aren't just buzzwords, but essential to sustainable IT architectures
* You have broad technical expertise and interest in technology trends
* You feel particularly comfortable in interdisciplinary teams and global contexts
* You have experience with hyperscalers, with additional certifications from AWS, Azure, GCP, AliCloud, or TencentCloud
* You're good at understanding and communicating complex topics in English, Arabic is a plus
* Flexibility and willingness to travel to our client locations in the Middle East and beyond

What You'll Bring
  
  
Shaping the digital transformation of globally leading companies, ensuring their success by evaluating our clients' digital capabilities and performing feasibility studies
  
  
Managing small, agile development teams in strategic IT implementation programs, establish modern practices like DevOps and CI/CD, and be responsible for the technical implementation of crucial digital requirements such as cyber resilience
  
  
Analyzing, developing, and optimizing cutting-edge, customized IT architectures while applying your comprehensive understanding of legacy IT, enterprise solutions, and current market developments such as cloud computing, microservices and blockchain.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
We make sure you never stop growing. You'll tackle exciting, high-impact challenges every day, supported by a passionate team of talented colleagues who share your drive for excellence and keep connect long after your case wraps up. Our collaborative, open culture gives you the freedom to explore and perfect your strengths, backed by individual learning opportunities and recognized certifications.

Lead the strategic planning, capacity forecasting, and continuous evolution of enterprise IT cloud infrastructure across private, public, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments.

About the Role: Cloud Infra & App Modernization (Presales Architect)

Location - Riyadh - KSA

Salary - 30 K SAR

**About Role -**

We are seeking a skilled Presales Azure Solution Architect to design and present innovative Microsoft Azure solutions tailored to client needs. This role blends technical expertise in Azure IaaS, PaaS, AKS, and cloud security with strong presales capabilities, including solution design, proposal creation, and client engagement. You will work closely with sales teams to demonstrate the value of Azure solutions and support client success.

**Responsibilities -**

• Architect and deploy Azure solutions, including IaaS (Virtual Machines, AVS) and PaaS (App Services).

• Manage Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) for scalable, secure containerized workloads.

• Implement robust networking and security solutions using Azure tools (Security Center, Key Vault, AAD).

• Automate deployments with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and IaC tools (Terraform, ARM).

• Collaborate with sales teams to design solutions, create proposals, and present to clients.

**Requirements -**

• 10+ years of experience in Azure IaaS, PaaS, AKS, and networking.

• Strong presales experience, including solution design, technical presentations, and proposal writing.

• Expertise in Azure security, DevOps, and automation tools.

• Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to diverse audiences.

• Certifications: Azure Solutions Architect Expert preferred; additional certifications in Azure DevOps and security are a plus.

**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion
  
  
AWS is looking for Data Center Engineers/Technicians to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team. Data Center Technicians are the primary resolver and troubleshoot and solve a range of datacenter infrastructure issues including, but not limited to: hardware, fiber, networking, and related problems. You will be part of the Data Center Operations (DCO) team, overseeing the operation and maintenance of the IT infrastructure and hardware for data centers in AWS Cloud regions. You will become the primary resolver for your support team, and gain troubleshooting skills on different hardware and software cases.
  
  
You will be able to troubleshoot and solve most infrastructure issues and engage other appropriate solutions groups on more complex problems to drive solutions.

SAFETY

* Troubleshooting events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Performing root cause analysis of equipment failures

**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
We are looking for an Integration Engineer – IMS & UDM to design, integrate, configure, upgrade, and maintain telecom solutions within customer networks.
  
  
You will combine hands-on engineering with customer engagement and end-to-end delivery ownership, working across IMS, UDM, subscriber data, 4G/5G Core, and cloud-native environments. You will collaborate with customer technical teams, product experts, support organizations, and project stakeholders to successfully introduce and maintain services in live networks.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Engage with customers to understand requirements, resolve technical issues, present solutions, and coordinate implementation activities.
* Analyze network architecture, interfaces, capacity, dependencies, and operational constraints.
* Prepare and execute HLD, LLD, MoP, implementation, testing, upgrade, and rollback plans.
* Integrate and configure IMS and UDM network functions with surrounding systems.
* Perform software upgrades, patches, migrations, feature activation, and post-change validation.
* Verify licenses, subscribers, interfaces, redundancy, alarms, counters, and operational procedures.
* Troubleshoot signaling, configuration, performance, and service issues across SIP, Diameter, SS7/SCCP, HTTP/2, REST/SBA, TLS, and IP.
* Analyze logs, traces, alarms, counters, and packet captures to determine root causes and corrective actions.
* Support 4G/5G Core, VoLTE, VoNR, VoWiFi, roaming, interworking, and subscriber authentication use cases.
* Work with virtualized and cloud-native environments, including Kubernetes and CNF/VNF.
* Support customer acceptance testing, handover, knowledge transfer, and production stabilization.
* Participate in planned maintenance windows, production changes, migrations, failover testing, and service restoration when required.

**The skills you bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, IT, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Professional telecom integration experience, preferably within IMS, UDM, EPC/5GC, HSS/HLR, subscriber data, or service platforms.
* Strong knowledge of IMS technologies such as CSCF, TAS/Application Servers, SBC, and HSS/HLR.
* Experience with subscriber-data technologies such as UDM, UDR/UDSF, AUSF, HSS-FE, HLR-FE, CCDM, or CCSM.
* Hands-on experience with configuration, integration, upgrades, patching, feature activation, and troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of SIP

Job Description – Platform Engineer

**Job Title:**
Platform Engineer
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
Experienced Required: 5 to 10 years
  
Work Location: KSA

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced
**Platform Engineer**
to support the installation, configuration, integration, and operationalization of an on-premises modern data platform. The role will focus on infrastructure setup, platform administration, security integration, environment management, and platform reliability across Development, QA, and Production environments.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience deploying enterprise data platforms in highly secured environments, with strong troubleshooting, operational support, and infrastructure management capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

* Install, configure, and administer data platform components in an on-premises environment
* Deploy and manage
  **MinIO Object Storage**
  and
  **Apache Iceberg**
  -based data lakehouse architecture
* Install, configure, and optimize
  **Starburst**
  and/or
  **Dremio**
  platforms for data virtualization and querying
* Deploy, administer, and support
  **Apache Spark**
  clusters and processing services
* Install, configure, and manage
  **Informatica**
  components and ensure seamless integration with the platform ecosystem
* Configure and maintain Development, QA, and Production environments
* Integrate platform components with enterprise security services, including:
  + Identity & Access Management (IAM)
  + Privileged Access Management (PAM)
  + Active Directory / LDAP
  + Single Sign-On (SSO) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
* Implement and support Git-based DevOps and CI/CD practices
* Manage monitoring, logging, backup, disaster recovery, and operational readiness processes
* Collaborate with infrastructure, security, and application teams to ensure platform stability, availability, and performance
* Troubleshoot deployment, configuration, integration, and connectivity issues across the platform stack

Must-Have Skills

* MinIO Administration
* Apache Iceberg
* Starburst and/or Dremio Administration
* Apache Spark Administration
* Informatica Administration
* Linux System Administration
* VMware Infrastructure
* Docker and/or Kubernetes
* Git and CI/CD Integration
* IAM/PAM Integration
* Infrastructure Troubleshooting and Operational Support

Good-to-Have Skills

* Data Lakehouse Architecture
* Enterprise Security Architecture
* Performance Tuning and Capacity Planning
*

=======================================

**Job Title:** Platform Engineer  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
Experienced Required: 5 to 10 years  
Work Location: KSA

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are seeking an experienced **Platform Engineer** to support the installation, configuration, integration, and operationalization of an on-premises modern data platform. The role will focus on infrastructure setup, platform administration, security integration, environment management, and platform reliability across Development, QA, and Production environments.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience deploying enterprise data platforms in highly secured environments, with strong troubleshooting, operational support, and infrastructure management capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Install, configure, and administer data platform components in an on-premises environment.
* Deploy and manage **MinIO Object Storage** and **Apache Iceberg**-based data lakehouse architecture.
* Install, configure, and optimize **Starburst** and/or **Dremio** platforms for data virtualization and querying.
* Deploy, administer, and support **Apache Spark** clusters and processing services.
* Install, configure, and manage **Informatica** components and ensure seamless integration with the platform ecosystem.
* Configure and maintain Development, QA, and Production environments.
* Integrate platform components with enterprise security services, including:
  + Identity & Access Management (IAM)
  + Privileged Access Management (PAM)
  + Active Directory / LDAP
  + Single Sign-On (SSO) and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
* Implement and support Git-based DevOps and CI/CD practices.
* Manage monitoring, logging, backup, disaster recovery, and operational readiness processes.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, security, and application teams to ensure platform stability, availability, and performance.
* Troubleshoot deployment, configuration, integration, and connectivity issues across the platform stack.

**Must-Have Skills**
--------------------

* MinIO Administration
* Apache Iceberg
* Starburst and/or Dremio Administration
* Apache Spark Administration
* Informatica Administration
* Linux System Administration
* VMware Infrastructure
* Docker and/or Kubernetes
* Git and CI/CD Integration
* IAM/PAM Integration
* Infrastructure Troubleshooting and Operational Support

وصف الوظيفة:
  
  
**الغرض من الوظيفة**

* إعداد استراتيجية ومنهجيات تطوير الحلول والمنتجات بالموائمة مع استراتيجية المركز وإدارة البنية المؤسسية في قطاع الاستراتيجية والتميز المؤسسي وتقديم الدعم اللازم لنشر الوعي حول الآثار المترتبة على منهجيات تطوير الحلول وضمان التنسيق اللازم بين مختلف قطاعات المركز المعنية بإدارة وتطوير الحلول التقنية وضمان الإطلاق وفق المخطط له.

**الأدوار والمسؤوليات التخصصية:**

* إعداد استراتيجية ومنهجيات تطوير الحلول والمنتجات بالموائمة مع منهجيات الأجايل والديف أوبس وبالموائمة مع استراتيجية المركز وإدارة البنية المؤسسية في قطاع الاستراتيجية والتميز المؤسسي.
* رسم خارطة الطريق لتطوير الحلول والمنتجات وإدارتها على مدى دورة الحياة واعتماد المنهجيات والتنسيق مع إدارة البنية المؤسسية ومعمارية الحلول ومتطلبات الأعمال وإدارات الاختبارات لضمان توفر الموارد والمهارات اللازمة والاتفاق على مستويات الخدمة ومتطلبات الجودة والأداء وتحديد المسؤوليات والأدوار.
* البحث في طرق أتمتة عمليات وأنشطة تطوير وإدارة صيانة وتشغيل الحلول والمنتجات على مدى دورة الحياة والبحث عن فرص التطوير في أنشطة تطوير المنتجات.
* تقديم الدعم المساند لتطوير متطلبات الأعمال والمتطلبات التقنية والبيانات لتطوير الحلول وإدارة عمليات اختبارات المستفيدين النهائيين وضمان تحديد وموائمة معايير القبول للمنتجات.
* إدارة عمليات تطوير وإدارة الحلول والمنتجات بمنهجيات AGILE & DevOps وضمان تقديم الحلول التقنية والإدارية اللازمة لضمان موائمة عمليات تطوير وإدارة صيانة تشغيل الحلول والمنتجات.
* تقديم الدعم اللازم لنشر الوعي حول الآثار المترتبة على منهجيات تطوير الحلول وضمان التنسيق اللازم بين مختلف قطاعات المركز المعنية بإدارة وتطوير الحلول التقنية وضمان الإطلاق وفق المخطط له.
* مساندة إدارة الإنجاز في حل المشكلات في تطوير خطط تشغيلية لضمان التقدم وتطوير الحلول وفق المخطط له.
* تشكيل فرق تطوير وإدارة الحلول وتوضيح الأدوار والمسؤوليات وضمان المساءلة في عمليات تطوير وإدارة الحلول بمنهجية أجايل وديف أوبس وضمان تنسيق الاختبارات والإطلاقات مع قطاع العمليات التقنية.
* التنسيق والموائمة مع مدراء المنتجات لضمان تحقيق الحلول التقنية لمستهدفاتها ولضمان حل المشكلات والمعوقات والحفاظ على مسارات مستمرة لضمان تطوير وترابط الحلول والمنتجات.

**المؤهلات والخبرات للوظيفة**
**المؤهل التعليمي:**

* درجة البكالوريوس في علوم الحاسب الآلي، إدارة الأعمال أو ما يعادلها

**الشهادات المهنية/ الإضافية:**

* شهادة الماجستير في علوم الحاسب الآلي إدارة الأعمال أو ما يعادلها

**الشهادات المهنية مثل:**

* الشهادات المهنية مثل: Project Management Professional (PMP), Agile PMP,
* Certified DevOps Leader (DOL)

Contract Type: Permanent

Job Location: Dammam - Kingdom of Saudi Arabia

Under the authority of the Maintenance Manager, the AGL Engineer is responsible for the inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of Aeronautical Ground Lighting (AGL) at airport facilities. This role ensures system reliability, safety compliance, and operational efficiency by conducting preventive and corrective maintenance, collaborating across teams, and maintaining detailed records.

  
  

Job Description

  

* Conduct routine inspections and preventive maintenance of Aeronautical Ground Lighting (AGL) systems, including runway and taxiway lighting, guidance signs, circuits, cables, transformers, Constant Current Regulators (CCRs), and associated control and monitoring equipment.

* Identify, troubleshoot, and promptly address faults to maintain the safe and reliable operation of AGL systems.

* Replace or repair damaged and malfunctioning components in response to planned maintenance or emergency requests, minimizing system downtime.

* Perform electrical, functional, and operational tests after maintenance or repair to verify system performance and confirm that equipment is safe to return to service.

* Analyze system alarms, circuit faults, and equipment malfunctions to determine root causes and implement appropriate corrective actions.

* Respond to emergency callouts and participate in a 24/7 standby rotation, as required.

* Follow airport safety requirements, electrical safety procedures, operational rules, and approved standard operating procedures during all work activities.

* Ensure the required permits and work documents, including LOA permits and AWP documentation, are available and approved before work begins.

* Conduct Toolbox Talks and safety briefings with the shift team, promoting clear communication and awareness of worksite and airside hazards.

* Coordinate with the Airport Operations Team and other relevant stakeholders to obtain work approvals, arrange access, and complete operational handovers following maintenance.

* Accurately update work orders and preventive and corrective maintenance records in Oracle or other designated systems.

* Prepare and submit clear shift reports detailing work performed, AGL faults and alarms, equipment status, outstanding issues, and other relevant activities.

* Participate in technical and safety training to maintain up-to-date knowledge of AGL equipment, airport standards, and applicable procedures.

* Reco

job_description:
SCADA Automation Technician

**Job Summary**

The SCADA Automation Technician installs, maintains, troubleshoots, and supports SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) systems and the related field automation equipment. The role helps keep plants, utilities, or facilities monitored and controlled reliably, with minimal downtime. The position reports to the SCADA/Automation Engineer or Maintenance Manager.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, and commission SCADA components, including PLCs, RTUs, HMIs, sensors, and field instruments
* Monitor SCADA systems and respond to alarms, faults, and communication failures
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, and instrumentation problems and restore operations quickly
* Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on control panels, instruments, and communication devices
* Calibrate and test sensors, transmitters, actuators, and control loops
* Support the engineer with PLC and HMI programming changes, backups, and updates
* Maintain and troubleshoot industrial communication networks (Modbus, Profibus, Ethernet/IP, OPC, fiber, radio)
* Keep documentation current, including as-built drawings, wiring diagrams, I/O lists, and maintenance logs
* Perform data backups and restoration for PLC, HMI, and SCADA servers
* Follow cybersecurity practices and report suspicious system behavior
* Apply HSE procedures, permit-to-work, and lockout/tagout rules during site work
* Prepare incident, maintenance, and shift handover reports

**Qualifications**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Control, or Automation Engineering (or equivalent technical qualification)
* 5 years of experience in SCADA, PLC, or industrial automation support
* Relevant certifications are a plus (e.g., vendor PLC/SCADA training, ISA, or cybersecurity awareness for ICS)

**Skills and Competencies**

* Hands-on experience with PLC platforms (Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Schneider, ABB) and SCADA software (WinCC, Ignition, iFIX, Wonderware, or similar)
* Ability to read electrical schematics and P&IDs
* Good knowledge of industrial protocols and networking basics
* Proficient with multimeters, loop calibrators, and diagnostic tools
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Clear technical documentation and communication in English (Arabic is a plus)
* Ability to work independently and in a team, including under pressure

**Job Purpose**

The SAP FI-CO Consultant is responsible for implementing, configuring, maintaining, and optimizing SAP Financial Accounting (FI) and Controlling (CO) modules to support the company's financial operations, cost management, budgeting, and reporting requirements. The role ensures the effective integration of SAP FI-CO with other SAP modules, particularly Materials Management (MM), Sales and Distribution (SD), and Production Planning (PP), to support accurate financial reporting and cost control across the company's cable manufacturing operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. SAP FI – Financial Accounting**

* Configure and maintain SAP FI components, including General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting (AA), and Bank Accounting.
* Support financial closing activities, including month-end and year-end closing processes.
* Ensure accurate financial postings, account reconciliations, and compliance with applicable accounting policies and procedures.
* Support the preparation of financial statements and management reports through SAP.
* Troubleshoot and resolve SAP FI issues and provide ongoing functional support to finance users.

**2. SAP CO – Controlling and Cost Management**

* Configure and maintain SAP CO functionalities, including Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, and Product Costing.
* Support standard cost estimates, cost component structures, and product cost calculations for cable manufacturing products.
* Analyze production costs, material consumption, labor costs, manufacturing overhead, and cost variances.
* Support production order costing, work-in-progress (WIP) calculations, and variance analysis.
* Assist in profitability analysis and margin reporting to support management decision-making.
* Support budgeting, cost allocation, and cost planning processes.

**3. SAP S/4HANA and System Integration**

* Support SAP S/4HANA FI-CO configuration, maintenance, enhancements, and process optimization.
* Ensure effective integration between FI-CO and other SAP modules, including MM, SD, and PP.
* Ensure accurate financial impact from procurement, inventory movements, production activities, and sales transactions.
* Support data migration, system testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and validation of financial data.
* Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and SAP implementation projects as required.

**4. Business Support and Process Improvement**

**Position Summary:**
Oversees internal solution design, testing, and migration across Oracle Fusion Purchasing, Sourcing, Procurement Contracts, Inventory, and Supplier Portal. Requires direct experience in EPC project-driven procurement, site material receiving, long-lead equipment sourcing, and sub-contract agreement management.

**Key Responsibilities & EPC Specific Duties:**

·      
**Project Procurement & Sourcing Design:**
Shadow vendor workshops for Purchase Requisitions, RFQs, Blanket Agreements, and Sourcing rules tailored to site construction bill of quantities (BOQ).

·      
**Site Material & Logistics Flow:**
Validate material issuance to project WBS tasks, direct site receiving routines, warehouse store management, equipment spare parts tracking, and scrap management.

·

Direct the extraction, cleansing, and loading of Item Masters, Approved Supplier Lists (ASL), Open Purchase Orders, Subcontract Agreements, and Site Inventory balances from D365.

·

Deploy the Oracle Supplier Portal for online vendor bidding, sub-contractor progress submittals, and site material delivery notifications (ASNs).

·      
**Buyer-Furnished Materials (BFM):**
Design and validate inventory control processes for client-supplied and buyer-furnished materials issued to subcontractors.

**Required Qualifications & Mandatory EPC Experience:**

·      
**Education:**
Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Mechanical/Civil Engineering, or Business.

·      
**Mandatory EPC Industry Experience:**
Minimum 5+ years managing supply chain, site procurement, or material logistics directly within an EPC or heavy construction company (MANDATORY).

·      
**Oracle SCM Cloud Expertise:**
Successfully completed at least 2 end-to-end Oracle Fusion SCM Cloud implementations.

·      
**D365 Domain Knowledge:**
Practical experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Trade & Logistics / Supply Chain module data structures.

**Required Professional Certifications:**

·      Oracle Procurement Cloud Implementation Professional (Mandatory)

·      APICS / ASCM Certified in Supply Chain Professional (CSCP) or CPIM (Highly Desirable)

·      Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) (Desirable)

We are seeking an experienced IT Business Analyst to support a digital transformation projects.

job_description:
**What We Need**
In this role you will be responsible for accounting and reporting for a number of legal entities in scope of the Oivan Group. On a monthly basis you are in charge of the month-end closing process, ensuring quality and timely reporting of the financial results, ensure accounts are reconciled and key controls are performed. The tasks might also include preparing monthly payrolls for the company’s employees. On an annual basis you support preparation of local financial statements and coordinate with auditors.
  
  
In this role you will be also responsible for finance activities within the Order-to-Cash (OTC) and Purchase-to-Pay (PTP) domains.
  
  
OTC includes handling bank statement postings, allocation of incoming payments, customer refunds and reconciliations. You have an important role in securing the companies’ cashflow by taking ownership of collection activities, aging reporting and bad debt handling. This also includes liaising with key Oivan customers, analyzing the project POs & contracts and deliveries, communicating with customers during the delivery process, monitoring the agreed settlements, sending invoices and following up with customers, revisiting and reminding and keeping record of collection process.
  
  
PTP includes handling purchase invoice processing, payments, query and escalation handling, AP maintenance, month-end closing activities including accruals, reconciliations and internal controls. You support the vendor master data maintenance and also support the local travel & expense process including processing of claims, credit card and corporate travel account administration. You are ultimately responsible that master data (vendors, customer and employees) of your entity is correct and up-to-date in Oivan financial systems.
  
  
You are supported by other members of Oivan finance team and collaborate closely with business stakeholders as well as other internal teams. You have strong excel skills and know how to optimize finance systems and constantly look for continuous improvement of daily activities.
  
  
Further, you play a key role in continuously improving and enhancing our local accounting and reporting processes. You are quickly able to adapt to new processes and tools, can resolve any problem quickly and understand how to optimise our systems and ways of working. The role also includes participation in various finance development projects.
  
  
**What You Have**
Qualifications and requirements:

Orient energy trading company is an energy-focused trading business based in Coimbatore South, Tamil Nadu, India. The company operates within regional and national markets, facilitating the trade and distribution of energy-related products. **Job Summary**

Express Food Company (ALBAIK) is looking for a motivated Internal Audit Specialist to join our Restaurant Audit team. You’ll carry out restaurant audit fieldwork across financial, operational and people areas in our restaurants in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain. The role protects revenue, stock and Company assets in one of the region’s fastest-growing QSR businesses.

**Purpose**

To carry out the approved restaurant audit plan and record results accurately, keeping internal controls strong across our restaurant network.

**Why Join Us**

At Express Food Company, Internal Audit protects the business as it grows. In this role, you’ll start your audit career in the field, testing the controls that matter most: cash, sales, inventory, POS and people. You’ll get structured on-the-job training and support towards certifications such as CIA. If you’re a detail-oriented Accounting graduate eager to learn, we invite you to join our Internal Audit team.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Complete assigned restaurant audit visits in line with the monthly coverage plan.
* Perform cash and safe counts, plus sales and settlement reconciliations across all channels.
* Conduct inventory counts and FIFO, expiry, transfer and wastage testing.
* Test POS access, voids, discounts and overrides, as well as expenses and petty cash.
* Review payroll and people records, and Baladiya and regulatory compliance.
* Gather audit evidence and prepare clear, cross-referenced working papers.
* Draft audit observations and validate closure of agreed corrective actions.
* Escalate any suspected fraud, obstruction or refusal of access immediately.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (preferred), or a related degree with at least 15 SOCPA-accepted accounting credit hours.
* **No experience required**
  for Bachelor’s holders. Accounting Diploma holders need 2+ years of relevant experience.
* Basic understanding of internal controls and audit evidence.
* Strong attention to detail and a willingness to learn.
* Good Microsoft Excel and Word skills.
* Fluent in Arabic and English.
* Valid driving licence and readiness to travel across KSA and Bahrain.
* Saudi nationality required. SOCPA Associate Membership is required, or must be obtained within the Company’s specified period.

* تنفيذ الجولات التفتيشية الدورية على المصانع.

**2. تقييم المخاطر**

* تحديد المخاطر المرتبطة بالعمليات والمعدات والمواد.
* إجراء ومراجعة تقييمات المخاطر.
* اقتراح إجراءات التحكم بالمخاطر وفق التسلسل الهرمي للسيطرة على المخاطر.

* مراجعة خطط الطوارئ والإخلاء.
* المشاركة في تنفيذ تمارين الإخلاء والطوارئ.
* دعم الاستجابة للحوادث والحرائق والحالات الطارئة.

* الإبلاغ الفوري عن الحوادث والإصابات والحالات الخطرة.

* إعداد تقارير الحوادث والإجراءات التصحيحية والوقائية.
* متابعة الإجراءات لمنع تكرار الحوادث.

**5. المقاولون والأعمال عالية الخطورة**

* متابعة التزام المقاولين بمتطلبات السلامة.
* التحقق من تصاريح العمل عند الحاجة.
* متابعة أعمال الارتفاع، اللحام والقطع، الرفع، الأعمال الكهربائية والأماكن المحصورة.
* رفع التوصيات أو إيقاف العمل عند وجود خطر وشيك وفق الصلاحيات والإجراءات المعتمدة.

* تنفيذ برامج التوعية اليومية والأسبوعية بالسلامة.

* تعزيز ثقافة السلامة لدى العاملين والمقاولين.

**7. التقارير وقياس الأداء**

* إعداد التقارير اليومية والأسبوعية والشهرية.
* متابعة إغلاق الملاحظات والمخالفات.
* متابعة مؤشرات مثل نسبة الالتزام، إغلاق الملاحظات، الحوادث، المخاطر عالية الخطورة، والتدريب.

**Description**
**Position Title:**
Sr. QC Engineer - Forging
  
  
**Position ID:**
QLTY-016
  
  
**Department:**
Quality
  
  
**Function:**
Quality Control
  
  
**Reports To:**
QC Manager
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To ensure that all forging products meet internal quality standards and customer specifications by implementing and maintaining effective quality control processes. The Quality Control Engineer plays a critical role in minimizing defects, improving production efficiency, and ensuring compliance with industry standards and certifications.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Quality Inspection and Control**

* Drive the QC procedure implementation across the forging shop as per the organization procedure and expectations
* Controlling of non-conforming product within the plant as per the NCR procedure including the internal NCR management
* Preparation of forging ITP and product inspection plan for both internal & external to ensure the product quality
* Perform quality inspections on raw materials, in-process components, and finished products related to forging in accordance with material standards and API 20B requirements
* Record inspection results and analyze quality data to identify trends and issues
* Manage the day-to-day inspection activities in the forging shop floor
* Liaise with third party inspection agencies for the inspection and related activity
* Responsible for final product clearance as per the quality requirements.

**Problem Solving and Continuous Improvement**

* Analyze root causes of defects and establish corrective and preventive actions
* Provide quality feedback to improve production processes.

**Quality System Management**

* Maintain and improve quality management systems such as ISO 9001 and APIQ1
* Manage the customer or third-party audit along with QA.

**Inspection Equipment Management**

* Manage calibration and maintenance of inspection equipment
* Operate equipment to ensure measurement accuracy.

**Requirements**
*Education*

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in quality control within a manufacturing environment, preferably in heavy open die forging
* Experience or knowledge in API Q1 and 20B is preferred.

*Technical Skills*

* Proficiency in using inspection tools (e.g., calipers, micrometers, CMM, ultrasonic testers)
* Familiarity with quality inspection such as visual and NDE methods

Commercial Director | Hygiene & Cleaning Solutions | KSA

Function: Commercial (Sales, Marketing, CRM, Business Development)

Industry: Industrial Hygiene Solutions

Location: Saudi Arabia

Reports To: CEO

Black Tie Consultancy is exclusively partnering with a market-leading hygiene and cleaning solutions company in Saudi Arabia to identify a Commercial Director. This is a senior leadership role for an executive who has built commercial teams before and can bring structure and ambition to a sales organisation in a competitive B2B market.

What you’ll be doing:

You’ll own the full commercial agenda across Sales, Marketing, CRM and Business Development, accountable for revenue growth, market share and how the company goes to market across the Kingdom. That covers commercial strategy, pricing, key accounts and channels, a multi-disciplinary team across several KSA locations, and the rollout of a data-driven CRM culture.

What we’re looking for:

15+ years of commercial leadership, ideally in hygiene, cleaning solutions, chemicals or B2B industrial distribution

A proven record of revenue growth or commercial turnaround in a product and solutions-led B2B business

Experience leading Sales, Marketing and BD together under one mandate

Hands-on CRM leadership: you’ve implemented or transformed one, not just used one

Sector knowledge in one or more of food & beverage, healthcare, hospitality, industrial or poultry processing

You’re the right fit if you:

Have modernised a sales model and built a performance culture, not just inherited one

Make decisions based on pipeline visibility and customer insight

Are comfortable presenting at board level and managing complex client relationships

Want the autonomy to build and execute your own commercial vision

What makes this role different:

You’ll sit at the leadership table of a well-established KSA business with a full commercial mandate, a rare level of autonomy. Food safety and hygiene compliance is a priority across every regulated sector, so the market has real headroom. The package includes base salary, performance-linked bonus and executive benefits.

To apply, send your CV to contact@blacktieconsultancy.com with the subject line “Commercial Director - KSA”. All applications are handled in strict confidence.

**Job Purpose**
Develop and manage compelling, consistent brand content across digital and communication channels. The Brand Content Senior Specialist leads content planning and production, strengthens brand storytelling, and collaborates with internal teams to deliver engaging content aligned with business objectives, audience needs, and brand guidelines.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities**

* Develop Brand Content Strategy: Translate brand positioning, marketing priorities, and audience insights into content strategies and plans that support business objectives.
* Lead Content Planning: Create and manage content calendars across relevant channels, coordinating topics, formats, timelines, and publishing requirements.
* Create and Edit Content: Write, edit, and oversee high-quality content for websites, social media, email campaigns, presentations, internal communications, and other brand touchpoints.
* Shape Brand Voice and Storytelling: Maintain a consistent brand voice and messaging framework, ensuring content is clear, engaging, accurate, and appropriate for each audience and channel.
* Manage Content Production: Develop creative briefs and work with design, marketing, product, communications, and external partners to produce content that meets project objectives and quality standards.
* Optimize Digital Content: Apply SEO principles and channel best practices to improve content visibility, accessibility, engagement, and performance.

job_description:
**Description**
Tuwaiq Casting & Forging is seeking an organised and operationally focused Internal Logistics Coordinator to join the Production Control Department within the Operations Division. Reporting to the Manager, this role is responsible for managing the movement and staging of materials within the manufacturing facility, ensuring raw materials, components, and finished products are efficiently transferred between warehouses, production shops, packing areas, and storage locations to support uninterrupted manufacturing operations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Coordinate the internal flow of products and by-products between departments, including melting, casting, forging, machining, heat treatment, NDE, painting, and packing areas
* Oversee the entire process of receiving, prioritising, and allocating requests for heavy machinery and internal transport equipment
* Ensure timely delivery of products and by-products to workplaces as requested, without delay
* Organise and track internal transport operations including forklifts, trucks, and trailers, ensuring all heavy machinery is operated safely and efficiently
* Prioritise and schedule internal transport in accordance with production urgency
* Monitor and evaluate individual team member performance and ensure proper timekeeping and attendance management
* Schedule and oversee routine and special heavy equipment maintenance; coordinate with external maintenance service providers in the event of major breakdowns
* Track and record all product and by-product transfers using Excel or relevant systems
* Prepare internal logistics documentation and maintain accurate system records
* Identify process improvement opportunities to streamline internal logistics and reduce waste or delays
* Adhere to all company policies and safety standards in all logistics activities.

**Requirements**
Education & Experience
  
  

* High school diploma or equivalent; technical or logistics education is preferred
* Minimum 5 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, or warehouse operations within the manufacturing sector.

Technical Competencies
  
  

* Familiarity with inventory management systems and ERP platforms
* Basic computer skills including Excel and data entry
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Strong leadership and communication skills
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple tasks simultaneously with high time efficiency

I&C Technician will carry out maintenance, installation, overhauling and modification activities on plant’s instrumentation and control systems and equipment in accordance with standard maintenance procedures, HSE guidelines and quality standards to attain effective functionality and reliability.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**I&C Maintenance**

* Carry out required routine preventative instrumentation and control maintenance work according to set schedule and ACWA NOMAC procedures to facilitate continuous operations.
* Monitor the physical condition of all systems and equipment in assigned plant and report non-conformances to Instrumentation and Control Engineer / Supervisor to facilitate effective maintenance of all ACWA NOMAC facilities as per set Quality/ HSE standards.
* Respond to instrumentation and control failures and implement corrective actions in adherence with procedures and guidelines to reduce downtime and maximize functionality of equipment.
* Troubleshoot using necessary tools and spare parts including diagnosis, dismantling, repair, part change, checking, cleaning and reassembly to validate that all instruments are well calibrated and in good working condition for smooth operations.
* Diagnose causes of malfunction or failure of operational equipment such as control valves, transmitters, etc. and take corrective measures in collaboration with Instrumentation and Control Engineer / Supervisor.
* Read and understand technical manuals, control diagrams and system diagrams and apply the knowledge to carry out maintenance and troubleshooting tasks, to prepare for the instrument and control maintenance to systems and equipment in the assigned area.
* Align, adjust and calibrate systems and equipment according to specifications and to maintain records of repairs, calibrations and tests.

**Documentation**

* Update the maintenance logbook and record details of work carried out including defaults, problems, various findings and conditions of all instrumentation and control systems to ensure timely availability of information and organized referencing.

* Adhere to all relevant health, safety, security and environmental procedures, instructions and controls so that the safety of employees and environmental compliance can be guaranteed.

Job Description – Data Engineer

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
**Work Location: KSA**
**Experience Required:**
Hands-on experience with Spark development, Informatica integration solutions, and enterprise data platforms.

Role Overview

We are looking for a
**Data Engineer**
to build, configure, and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and consumption workloads on a modern on-premises lakehouse platform. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Spark-based development, enterprise data lake/lakehouse implementations, and Informatica-based integration solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop scalable data ingestion and transformation pipelines
* Build, optimize, and maintain Spark-based ETL/ELT workloads
* Develop and manage data models and datasets using Apache Iceberg tables
* Implement and support data integration workflows using Informatica
* Enable analytics and data consumption through Denodo, Starburst, and/or Dremio
* Develop secure, governed, and scalable data pipelines aligned with enterprise standards
* Support batch and near real-time data processing requirements
* Implement data quality, metadata management, and validation controls
* Collaborate with Platform Engineers on deployment, integration, and operationalization activities
* Support migration, testing, and production rollout initiatives
* Troubleshoot and optimize data pipeline performance, reliability, and scalability

Must-Have Skills

* Apache Spark (PySpark and/or Scala Spark)
* Apache Iceberg
* Informatica Data Integration
* MinIO Object Storage
* Denodo
* SQL and Data Modeling
* Data Warehousing Concepts
* ETL/ELT Development
* Git Version Control

Good-to-Have Skills

* Starburst and/or Dremio
* Data Governance and Metadata Management
* Data Quality Frameworks
* CI/CD for Data Pipelines
* Python
* Kafka or Streaming Technologies
* Lakehouse Architecture Patterns
* Experience with enterprise data lake and lakehouse implementations
* Performance tuning and optimization of large-scale data workloads

We are recruiting an A&D System Manager for a dedicated full-time team delivering accreditation at a major international multi-sport event. The role sits within our client's Accreditation function. * Get the system tested, validated and fully ready before the event begins
* Keep the system live and supported across all venues during the event

*System Management*

* Manage system settings, accreditation categories, user permissions, access privileges and operational workflows in line with approved requirements

**Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia  
**Employment Type:** Full-time (40 hours per week)

**About the Opportunity**  
Arventa Group is recruiting an experienced and compassionate Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) on behalf of a client in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will support a highly individualized clinical and educational program for a child with autism and complex behavioral, communication, and adaptive needs.

- Conduct functional behavior assessments, skill assessments, and ongoing clinical evaluations.

-Apply function-based, evidence-informed strategies to address aggression, self-injury, elopement, and other challenging behaviors.

-Oversee programs covering communication, social skills, play, executive functioning, cognition, adaptive living, academics, and independence.  
-Collaborate with educators and allied professionals to adapt instructional strategies.  
-Monitor skill acquisition, maintenance, and generalisation.

**Description**
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is seeking a Logistics Executive for our Delivery Partner Management team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing Amazon's Delivery Service Partners, being the bridge between partners and Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Quickly understand the business issues and challenges of transportations operations; identify strengths/weaknesses and suggest areas for improvement
* Map business requirements, understand business process, study and analyze workflows, design solutions and prepare functional specifications
* Be data driven, develop and report performance metrics, executive updates, forecasting, budgeting and analysis to identify potential opportunities for improvements
* Deep dive and acquire an extensive knowledge of the industry practices and apply when solving business problems

A day in the life
  
  
1- Monitoring operational performance of the program
  
  
2- Own network compliance score for the associated accounts
  
  
3- Tracking capacity reliability of the partners
  
  
4- Launching multiple new projects or services via coordination with stakeholders and on ground partners
  
  
5- Touchbase with partners as part of regular or ad-hoc connects to ensure business running smoothly
  
  
4- Coordinating with various stakeholders and DSPs to resolve issues
  
  
**About The Team**
Amazon's Delivery Partner Management team is responsible for managing all Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across networks across the region. They manage the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business. As trusted advisors, they work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges, influence their business planning and strategy, identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are set up for success.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Bachelor's degree

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. **About the Company**

Astek Middle East is part of Astek, a global engineering and technology consulting group founded in France in 1988 and now present on five continents. The Middle East entity delivers IT and technology services across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Jordan, supporting clients in public and government, healthcare, transportation, banking, retail, airlines, and tourism. With 10,000 employees worldwide and revenue of €620 million in 2023, Astek focuses on digital transformation and complex systems engineering for international clients. The group promotes a strong culture of entrepreneurship, innovation, and continuous skills development. More information is available on the Astek Saudi Arabia and UAE country pages, and candidates can reach Astek Middle East at contact-astekme@astek-international.com.

* Conduct Arabic and English keyword research, search-intent analysis, competitor research, and content optimization tailored to each audience.
* Plan, execute, and optimize paid digital campaigns across relevant advertising platforms, monitoring performance against agreed business objectives.
* Manage social media channel

**Job Title : BIM Engineer – Electrical - Project**

**Location : Saudi Arabia**

**Role Purpose**

The Electrical BIM Engineer will support the development, coordination, review, and management of electrical BIM models and related digital deliverables across design development, IFC readiness, shop drawing production, construction coordination, as-built development, AIM preparation, and digital handover.

The Electrical BIM Engineer will work under the guidance and reporting of the BIM Manager and closely with the Technical Engineering Team to ensure that electrical BIM information is accurate, coordinated, technically aligned, constructible, properly documented, and compliant with the project BIM Execution Plan, Model Development Standard, Level of Information Need, BIM QA/QC procedures, Common Data Environment workflows, and ABCC Technical Engineering requirements.

The role requires an engineering-based BIM professional with an Electrical / Building Services/ICT Engineering background, not a drafting-only profile. The candidate shall be capable of supporting electrical BIM production, model information quality, multidisciplinary coordination, clash resolution, constructability review, containment coordination, builders’ work coordination, shop drawing coordination, site support, QTO / 4D / 5D data readiness, asset information, testing and commissioning interface support, and project digital delivery workflows.

The Electrical BIM Engineer shall actively support BIM coordination, technical coordination, design coordination, electrical coordination, ELV/interface coordination, ICT package coordination including Building Management systems (BMS) and construction coordination meetings. The role shall present model issues clearly, explain electrical coordination constraints, support issue resolution, follow up assigned actions, and coordinate with relevant project stakeholders until closure.

**DUTIES PREFORMED**

**Electrical BIM Production & Model Information Quality**

* Develop, update, and maintain electrical BIM models in accordance with approved project BIM requirements, model standards, naming conventions, shared coordinates, levels, zones, worksets, systems, and CDE workflows.
* Model and manage electrical systems including power distribution, lighting, emergency lighting, small power, cable trays, trunking, conduits, busways / busducts, switchgear, transformers, generators, UPS systems, PV systems, distribution boards, panel boards, earthing, light

job_description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an exceptionally talented Field Engineer to join our site-based Construction Supervision team on a major landmark development project in Riyadh.

The project comprises the design, enabling, and main works for a large-scale destination development featuring several iconic assets, hospitality facilities, and supporting infrastructure. Delivered under a client governance framework with stringent programme, quality, safety, and sustainability requirements, the Construction Supervision Consultant (CSC) is responsible for providing independent, end-to-end supervision and management, ensuring that all works are completed, integrated, tested, commissioned, and handed over to support both successful operations and long-term legacy objectives.

  
  

What You'll Be Doing

* Monitor and supervise construction activities to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, contract requirements, and quality standards.
* Conduct regular site inspections and report on construction progress, quality, and safety performance.
* Coordinate with contractors, consultants, and project stakeholders to resolve technical and construction-related issues.
* Review method statements, inspection requests, material submissions, and work procedures.
* Verify that construction works are carried out in accordance with approved plans and applicable codes and standards.
* Assist in monitoring project schedules and identifying potential delays or risks.
* Maintain accurate site records, daily reports, and inspection documentation.
* Support testing, commissioning, and handover activities.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and sustainability requirements.
* Assist the Resident Engineer and Construction Manager in the successful delivery of project objectives.
  

  

What Required Skills You'll Bring

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in construction supervision, inspection, or site engineering on major building or infrastructure projects
