**About Noon Academy:**

Noon is a Saudi EdTech company. Noon Track runs inside schools: a hybrid programme that prepares students for Qudrat (قدرات) and Tahsili (تحصيلي), the national university-admission exams. Our students are 15 to 17 years old. Noon is becoming an AI-native company, department by department, and the number of schools we serve is growing. We believe every student deserves world-class teachers. And to make it happen, we’re reimagining everything about education: from cutting-edge tech to peer learning and physical spaces that spark curiosity.

* Hear about our vision directly from our CEO

**The role**

You will be the one designer who owns the student experience. Primarily that means the student app: where students study, work with an AI tutor, answer questions, and take part in activities, including games and head-to-head duels on a topic. You will also shape parts of the live classroom experience.

This is a Senior/Principal-level individual contributor Product Designer role. There is no design team underneath you and no manager drawing your roadmap. You take a problem from the first student conversation to the shipped screen, and you decide what to look at next.

**Why this role**

* One owner of the whole student experience, with a direct line to leadership.
* Speed: with AI in the workflow, ideas go from research to release in days, not quarters.
* An experimentation practice being built from the ground up, with you shaping it.
* A company expanding into more schools, with a long-term ambition to match.

**What You Will Do**

* Spend real time with students in Saudi schools. Interviews, focus groups, classroom observation. Turn what you hear into design decisions, and go back to check them.
* Design for Saudi Arabia, not for the generic "best practice" app. Patterns that work in London or San Francisco often fail here. You know why, and you can show it in your work.

**About Deloitte:**
When you work for us, you commit to a career at one of the largest and most prestigious professional services firms in the world. We have received numerous awards over the last few years, including Best Employer in the Middle East, and Best Consulting Firm, and the Middle East Training & Development Excellence Award.
  
  
**Our Purpose**
Deloitte makes an impact that matters. Every day we challenge ourselves to do what matters most—for clients, for our people, and for society. We serve clients distinctively, bringing innovative insights, solving complex challenges and unlocking sustainable growth. We inspire our talented professionals to deliver outstanding value to clients, providing an exceptional career experience and an inclusive and collaborative culture. We contribute to society, building confidence and trust in the markets, upholding the integrity of organizations and supporting our communities.
  
  
Our shared values guide the way we behave to make a positive, enduring impact:
  
  

* Lead the way
* Serve with integrity
* Take care of each other
* Foster inclusion
* Collaborate for measurable impact

During your tenure as a
**Consultant - Manager,**
you will demonstrate and develop your capabilities in the following areas.
  
  
**Assess and set direction**

* Assess current cybersecurity posture and maturity against NCA ECC-2:2024, NIST CSF 2.0 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022, and produce the current-state and maturity assessment report
* Define the target state, vision and guiding principles, turning ambiguity into clear options and a recommended path, and author the cybersecurity strategy
* Benchmark against peer organisations of similar scale, regulated KSA entities and global leading practice

Design the operating model
  
  

* Design and document the target operating model: structure, roles, RACI, capability map, and the split between in-house, managed-service and outsourced work
* Define the interfaces between cybersecurity, IT, OT, risk, legal, procurement and the business

**Build the roadmap and business case**

* Build the 3–5 years roadmap of costed initiatives, prioritized by risk reduction, regulatory need and cost, and keep it realistic for what the organisation can actually deliver, not a textbook ideal
* Prepare business cases, the investment profile and the annual budget input, linking security spend clearly to business value and risk reduction
* Track roadmap delivery and benefits; re-prioritize as development plan

job_description:
WSP is seeking an experienced Quantity Surveyor (MEP) to join our team on a major infrastructure construction supervision project in Madinah. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing all MEP quantity surveying activities, including measurement, valuation, cost control, payment certification, and variation assessment across a complex infrastructure environment.

Working closely with the Resident Engineer, Construction Supervision Team, Contractors, and Client representatives, the Quantity Surveyor (MEP) will play a key role in ensuring accurate commercial administration and contract compliance throughout the project lifecycle.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review and verify MEP-related quantities based on approved drawings and project specifications.
* Perform quantity take-offs, measurements, remeasurements, and quantity verification for infrastructure works.
* Evaluate and assess variations, change orders, claims, and additional works in accordance with contract requirements.
* Review contractors' interim payment applications and provide recommendations for certification.
* Monitor project costs and ensure compliance with approved budgets and contractual provisions.
* Verify completed work on site and coordinate with engineering and supervision teams regarding progress and measurements.
* Review Bills of Quantities (BOQ), specifications, preambles, and contract documents to ensure accurate valuation of works.
* Prepare cost estimates and quantity reports as required by the project.
* Maintain records of measurements, payment certificates, variation orders, and cost reports.
* Assist in the preparation of commercial correspondence and contractual documentation.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to resolve commercial and technical issues related to MEP works.
* Ensure all quantity surveying activities comply with project procedures, contract conditions, and industry best practices.

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Quantity Surveying, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 7–10 years of Quantity Surveying experience in tunnel and infrastructure projects, preferably on major infrastructure projects.
* Strong multidisciplinary MEP knowledge covering:
  + HVAC Systems
  + Fire Fighting Systems
  + Electrical Systems (HV/MV/LV)
  + ELV Systems
  + Telecommunications
  + SCADA Systems
  + Wet Utilities including Potable Water, Sewerage, Stormwater, and Irrigation Networks.
* Proven experience in q

job_description:
We are seeking a highly experienced
**Senior Network Engineer (SRv6)**
to join our team of networking subject matter experts. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, deploying, and optimizing complex, carrier-grade network infrastructures, with a strong focus on Segment Routing (SR) and Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6) to enhance network scalability, performance, and reliability.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and architect end-to-end network solutions leveraging Segment Routing (SR) and SRv6 protocols.
* Lead migration strategies from traditional MPLS architectures to modern SRv6-based environments.
* Oversee the deployment, configuration, and optimization of high-scale routing platforms across multi-vendor environments.
* Analyze network performance, conduct capacity planning, and ensure optimal network reliability and efficiency.
* Troubleshoot complex network latency, path selection, routing, and connectivity issues.
* Implement advanced traffic engineering solutions to optimize network paths and resource utilization.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior network engineers.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex network design and operational challenges.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align network architecture with business and service requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  10+ years of comprehensive experience in advanced network routing and infrastructure.
* **Routing Protocols:**
  Strong expertise in BGP, OSPF, and IS-IS.
* **Segment Routing:**
  Minimum 10 years of hands-on experience implementing, managing, and troubleshooting Segment Routing technologies.
* **SRv6:**
  At least 1 year of dedicated, hands-on experience designing and deploying SRv6 in production environments.
* **Certifications:**
  Must hold a current CCDP (Cisco Certified Design Professional) or CCIE (Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert) certification.
* **Troubleshooting:**
  Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex network performance, latency, pathing, and connectivity issues.
* **Network Architecture:**
  Experience designing and optimizing large-scale, carrier-grade network infrastructures.

**Desired Skills**

* Knowledge of network automation and programmability using Python, Ansible, NETCONF, and YANG.
* Strong understanding of Traffic Engineering (TE) and Network Slicing.
* Experience with multi-vendor routing platforms and next-generation networking technologies.

We are looking for an Operations Tech SME to support high-growth, technology-enabled operations. In this role, you will act as the bridge between Operations, Product, and Tech teams to ensure smooth launches, stable system workflows, and exceptional customer experience. You will troubleshoot system issues, validate operational accuracy, and support process readiness to enable successful day-one performance for new sites or products.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Lead operational readiness and support launch activities, ensuring workflows, tools, and processes function as expected.
  
  

* Diagnose and troubleshoot system issues by working closely with Tech, Product, and Operations teams.
* Conduct structured testing, validate process accuracy, and identify gaps before launch.
* Support data validation related to operational workflows and customer-facing promises.
* Coordinate with cross-functional partners to resolve defects and ensure readiness for go-live.
* Monitor performance post-launch, escalate issues, and drive timely root-cause resolution.
* Identify recurring patterns, propose long-term fixes, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders, providing timely updates, documentation, and status reports.

* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration
* 1+ years of technical support work, engineering or operations environment experience
* Experience performing data analysis using MS Excel and other Microsoft Office tools
* Experience in written and oral communication, including the ability to communicate with all levels in the organization (technical, business, executive)
* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

* Experience in technical support work, engineering, or an operations environment
* Understanding of workflow testing, UAT processes, or structured defect validation
* Ability to analyze root causes, identify patterns, and recommend long-term improvements

* Strong problem-solving skills with a bias for action and ownership

The Musco
**Saudi Arabia Team**
has an opening for an
**Import/Export Specialist**
at our
**Dammam, Saudi Arabia office.**
The primary purpose of this position is to provide leadership in working with freight carriers and the manufacturing team in the development and execution of import and export operations for the KSA Manufacturing Facility. If your experience aligns with the qualifications outlined below, we look forward to hearing from you!
  
  
**Essential Criteria**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in import and export operations.
* Strong command of both English and Arabic (reading, writing, and speaking)
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Strong problem-solving skills.
* High level of organization, with strong attention to detail.
* Self-motivated to work independently
* Proficient with computers and Office365 programs, including Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.

* Manage KSA inventory requests by creating and maintaining purchase orders for Purchasing & Receiving until shipment of the order is complete.

* Maintain and build freight carrier relationships.

To lead the plant’s operations and laboratory functions, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient production in line with contractual, quality, and HSE standards.

* Develop and implement operations strategy aligned with plant objectives.

* Report operational performance, risks, and improvements to senior management.

* Lead, develop, and manage operations teams (30–100 employees).
* Set clear objectives and drive high performance and engagement.

* Work closely with maintenance teams to ensure effective preventive and corrective maintenance.
* Support planned outages and ensure safe shutdown and restart activities

* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with all HSE standards.
* Lead incident response and ensure proper reporting and corrective actions.

**Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Monitor plant performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reliability.
* Implement operational improvements and best practices.

**Laboratory & Quality Control**

* Oversee laboratory operations and ensure compliance with quality and regulatory standards.
* Monitor production parameters to maintain optimal performance.

**Contracts & Inventory**

* Manage operational contracts and ensure cost-effective delivery service.
* Oversee inventory of chemicals, consumables, and equipment.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering.
* 10+ years of experience in power generation and/or water desalination plants.
* Proven experience in leadership/managerial role.

**Skills**

* Strong leadership and team management.
* Deep knowledge of plant operations.
* Strategic thinking and problem-solving.
* Budget and performance management.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management.

**Operation Manager**

Astek Middle East is part of Astek, a global engineering and technology consulting group founded in France in 1988 and now present on five continents. The Middle East entity delivers IT and technology services across Saudi Arabia, the Emirates, and Jordan, supporting clients in public and government, healthcare, transportation, banking, retail, airlines, and tourism. * Document integration procedures, channel configurations, troubleshooting steps, and operational standards.
* Support continuous improvement of integration operations and healthcare data exchange processes.

* **Saudi nationality is mandatory.**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Scien
